Yuj chi' ix yalxi jun ab'ix tik Jesús t'a winh: --Ha junel ay jun winh wan sb'ey t'a jun b'e skot t'a Jerusalén sk'och t'a Jericó. Ix yamji winh yuj juntzanh heb' elk'um. Ix laj elk'ajel tastak yet'nak winh yet' spichul winh. Ix mak'ji wekchaj winh, ijan ix cham winh smak'an heb'.
Haxo ix ek' jun winh sacerdote t'a jun b'e chi', tonhej ix b'atkan k'elan winh t'a winh, b'enhej ix ek'b'at winh.
Ix k'ochpax jun winh yinhtilal Leví, haxo ix yilanb'at winh ix mak'ji wekchaj chi' winh, ix sk'exb'ean sb'a winh t'a winh, ix ek'b'at winh.
Palta ix ek'pax jun winh aj Samaria ta'. Ayik ix yilan winh, ix ok' sk'o'ol winh t'a winh.

Ix k'och winh t'a stz'ey winh, ix yanhtan winh, ix yak'anoch aceite winh yet' wino b'ajtak ix lajwi chi'. Ix sb'ak'an winh. Ix yak'ank'e winh t'a yib'anh schej, ix yik'anb'at winh b'aj ay posado, ix stanhwan winh ta'.

Haxo t'a junxo k'u, ix yak'anelta chab' tumin winh t'a winh ay yik posado chi', ix yalan winh: Tzil wal janik' jun winh pena'ay tik. Tato niwan tza laj yuj winh, ol in tup t'ayach a ol in jax junelxo, xchikan winh.
Yuj chi' tzin k'anb'ej t'ayach, ¿mach junok heb' winh oxwanh tik yetanimail sb'a yet' winh ix yamji yuj heb' elk'um chi' tza na'a? xchi Jesús t'a winh k'ayb'um t'a ley Moisés chi'.
--Haton winh ix ok' sk'o'ol chi' t'a winh, xchi winh t'a Jesús. --Yel, hatoni. Yuj chi', ixik, icha chi' tzutej a b'a, xchi Jesús t'a winh.
Haxo ix b'at Jesús t'a yol b'e, ix k'och t'a jun aldea. Hata' ay jun ix skuch Marta. Ix scha'anoch Jesús chi' ix t'a yol spat.
Ay pax junxo ix snulej ix skuchan María. Ha ix María chi', ix em k'ojan ix t'a yichanh Jesús yik syab' ix tas syala'.

Haxo ix Marta chi', manh jantakok tas sk'ulej ix, ix k'och ix t'a Jesús chi', ix yalan ix: --Mamin, ¿tom max il jab'ok, to a ix in nulej tik, in yaktejkan ix t'a yol sk'ab' in munlajel tik in ch'okoj? Al t'a ix to skolwaj ix wet'ok, xchi ix.
Ix yalan Jesús t'a ix: --Marta, Marta, te ay ach och t'a ilk'olal yuj jantak tas tza k'ulej chi'.
Palta junnhej wal tas te yowalil sk'ulaji, haton jun chi' snib'ej ix María tik, yuj chi' malaj junok mach ol yal yik'anek' t'a ix, xchi t'a ix.

Ha junel wan slesalwi Jesús t'a jun lugar. Haxo ix lajwi slesalwi, ix yalan jun sk'ayb'um t'ay: --Mamin, ¿tom max onh a k'ayb'ej t'a lesal icha ix yutej winhaj Juan sk'ayb'an heb' sk'ayb'um? xchi winh t'ay.
Yuj chi' ix yalan Jesús t'a heb': --Icha tik tzeyutej he lesalwi: Ach ko Mam, niwanokab' elk'och t'a yichanh heb' anima. Ach ochokab' Yajalil t'a tik.
Ak' tas sko wa yet' tas tz'och kuj t'a junjun k'u.
Ak' lajwok ko mul, yujto a onh tik skak' niwank'olal heb' tz'och smul t'ayonh. Manh onh a cha ak'jok prowal, xe chi, xchi Jesús.
Ix yalanxi Jesús chi' t'a heb': --K'inalok ayex tzex k'och t'a junok eyamigo t'a chimilak'wal, tzeyalani: Ach wetanimail, k'e'anh wa'an, ak' in k'ex jaye'ok o'och,
yujto ay jun wamigo toto ix jawi b'aj ix xit'ek'i, malaj tas swak' t'ay, xe chi.
Tato tonhej stak'wielta t'ayex: Manh in a tzuntzejoch ta. Makanxo in pat, waynak inxo yet' heb' unin. Max yal-laj in k'e wan wak' t'ayach, ta xchi.
Swal t'ayex, manh yujok to yamigo ex sk'e wa'an yak' t'ayex, palta yujto aw tzeyak'och t'ay syab'i syak' t'ayex jantak tas tze k'an t'ay yik maxtzak he tzuntzej.
Yuj chi' swal t'ayex: k'anek, ha Dios ol ak'an t'ayex. Sayek, ol ilchaj eyu'uj. Awajanhek och t'a ti' puerta, ol jakjok te' t'ayex.
Yujto a mach sk'anani, scha'a. Ha heb' sayani, tz'ilchaj yuj heb'. Hanhejtona' heb' tz'awajoch t'a ti' puerta, sjakchaj te' t'a heb'.
Ha ex mamab'il ex, tato a junok eyuninal sk'anan junok nok' chay t'ayex, ¿tom a junok nok' chan tzeyak' t'ay?
Ta a junok nok' nholob' sk'an t'ayex, ¿tom a junok nok' sina'an tzeyak' t'ay?
Ha ex tik eyojtak eyak'an jab'ok tas wach' t'a heb' eyuninal wach'chom chuk ex. Okxom pax ko Mam ay t'a satcha'anh, ol yak' Yespíritu t'a heb' sk'anan t'ay, xchi Jesús t'a heb'.

Ha junel ay jun winh ayoch jun enemigo max uji slolon t'ay, yuj chi' max ujipaxlaj slolon winh yuj. Haxo Jesús ix ik'anel jun enemigo chi' t'a winh. Ichato chi' ix lolonk'e winh. Ix sat sk'ol heb' anima yuj jun chi'.
Palta ay heb' ix halani: --Ha jun winh tik syal yik'anel heb' enemigo winh yujto a winh Beelzebú yajalil heb' enemigo ayoch yet' winh, xchi heb'.
Ay juntzanhxo heb' snib'ej yak'an prowal Jesús. Yuj chi' ix sk'an yil junok milagro heb' sch'oxan spoder Dios.

Palta yojtakxo Jesús tas wan sna'an heb', yuj chi' ix yalan t'a heb': --K'inalok ay junok nación spoj sb'a heb' yajal t'ay, syak'an owal heb'. Tato icha chi', tz'ixtaxel snación heb' chi'. K'inalok ay junok patil heb' anima spoj sb'a yuj owal. Tato icha chi' sjuwiel jun patil heb' chi'.
Icha chi' yaj winh Satanás, tato spoj sb'a winh t'a yol yiko', ¿tom ol najtilax yopisio winh? Ha jun tik swal t'ayex, yujto a ex tik tzeyala' to swik'el heb' enemigo yuj spoder Beelzebú.
Palta tato icha chi', ¿mach ayoch yet' heb' he k'ayb'umal chi' ayik spechanel heb' enemigo heb'? Yuj chi' hanheja' heb' he k'ayb'umal chi' sch'oxanel he paltail.
Palta yujnhej spoder Dios tzin pechel heb' enemigo chi', yuj chi' scheklaji to toxo ix syamoch Dios yak'an Yajalil t'a he kal.
K'inalok ay junok winh winak te ay yip, ay syamk'ab' winh yik stanhwej spat, manh komonok syal yik'jielta sk'a'el winh.

Palta tato sk'och junokxo mach ek'al yip t'a winh, tato tz'ak'ji ganar winh yuj, tz'ik'jiek' jantak syamk'ab' winh ayoch yipok sk'o'ol chi' yet' pax masanil tas ay t'a winh. Sna'an winh tas syutej juntzanh syik'ek' chi'. Icha winh aj pat chi', icha chi' yaj winh diablo.
Ha heb' manh ayokoch wet'ok, ajk'o'ol heb' t'ayin. Ha heb' max molb'ankot heb' anima wet'ok, a heb' spechan saklem heb' anima chi'.
K'inalok ay junok enemigo tz'el t'a junok anima tiknaik, tzek' t'a tzinan lu'um, sayan b'aj syik' yip. Palta max ilchaj yuj. Yuj chi' sna'an icha tik: Ol in pax t'a in pat b'aj kotnak in, xchi.
Haxo yik sk'ochxi, syilan spixan jun anima chi', icha junok pat mesb'il yo'ol, wach' yilji.

Yuj chi' sb'atxi, sb'at yik'ankot ukwanhokxo heb' enemigo másto chuk t'a yichanh. Swach' och kajan heb' smasanil t'a jun anima chi'. Yuj chi', ste juwiel jun anima chi' icha t'a sb'ab'elal, xchi Jesús t'a heb'.
Yakb'an a Jesús wan yalan juntzanh chi', ay jun ix ix, ix awajk'e t'a skal heb' anima, ix yalan ix: --Te wach' yik jun ix ix b'aj ach alji, b'aj ach chuni, xchi ix t'a Jesús.
Haxo ix yalan Jesús chi' t'a ix: --Más wach' yik heb' tz'ab'an tas syal Dios, sk'anab'ajan heb', xchi.

Tzijtum anima ix och hoyan t'a spatik Jesús. Ix yalan t'a heb': --Ha wal heb' anima t'a jun pekti' tik, te chuk heb'. Yuj chi' tonhej sk'an yil junok milagro heb', junok sch'oxan spoder Dios. Palta anhej jun milagro ol ch'oxjok yil heb', haton jun icha sch'oxnak Dios yet' winh schekab' skuchan Jonás.
Yujto a winhaj Jonás chi' ch'oxannakel spoder Dios t'a heb' ay t'a chonhab' Nínive t'a peka'. Icha chi' waj a in Ak'b'il in kot yuj Dios woch animail tik, yik tzin ch'oxel spoder Dios t'a he kal.

Ayik ol ja sk'uhal sch'olb'itaj heb' anima, a jun ix yajal t'a Sur t'a peka', ol k'e wa'an ix, ol yalan he mul ix, yujto najat kotnak ix yab'i jantak sjelanil winhaj Salomón. Ha t'a tik, ay jun ek'al yopisio t'a yichanh winhaj Salomón chi', palta max kotlaj heb' anima smaklej yab' t'ay.

Ha heb' aj Nínive chi', snanak sb'a heb' yuj tas yalnak winhaj Jonás chi'. Haxo t'a tik ay jun ek'al yopisio t'a yichanh winhaj Jonás chi', palta max he na he b'a. Yuj chi', ayik ol ja sk'uhal sch'olb'itaj heb' anima, a heb' aj Nínive chi', ol k'e wa'an heb', ol yalan he mul heb'.
Ayik skak'anoch sk'ak'al ko candil, max kak'kan b'aj manh chekelok, max kak' pax och t'a yalanh junok tasi. Palta cha'anh skak'k'ei, yik wach' syil heb' tz'och t'a yol pat chi'.

Ha yol ko sat, icha yaj candil yaj t'a ko niwanil. Yuj chi' tato junnhej b'aj ayoch ko sat, sakil k'inal kaji, wach' skutej ko b'a yet' ko niwanil. Palta tato ch'okch'ok b'aj skak'och ko sat, tzonh kan t'a kal k'ik' k'inal yuj.
Tzeyil wal he b'a, yik wach' a jun sakil k'inal ayoch t'ayex, max meltzajxioch k'ik'alk'inalil.
Tato sakil k'inal yaj he niwanil smasanil, tato malaj jab'ok k'ik' k'inal ayoch t'ayex, sakilk'inalnhej ton eyaji, icha junok candil syak' sakil k'inal, xchi Jesús.
Ayik ix lajwi yalan juntzanh chi' Jesús, ay jun winh fariseo ix awtan yet' wa'el t'a spat. Tz'eyan ix aj em k'ojan b'aj ix wa chi'.
Haxo winh fariseo chi', ix sat sk'ol winh yilani to maj sb'iklaj sk'ab' ichataxon smodo heb'.

Palta ix yalan Jesús t'a winh: --Ha ex fariseo ex tik, lajan ex icha junok mach anhej spatik swaso yet' yuk'ab' sb'ikeli, haxo yo'ol, mi'iktak. Ichex ta', te wach'nhej tzeyutej he b'a t'a yichanh heb' anima. Palta haxo t'a elk'altak, tonhej tzex och b'eyumal yuj eyixtan heb' anima chi', yuj eyak'an snib'ej he pek'al.
Te malaj jab'ok he pensar. ¿Tom manh eyojtakok to a jun ixb'o'an juntzanh tas skil tik, ha' ix b'oanpax juntzanh tas manh chekeloklaj, haton ko pensar?
Oktom t'a smasanil he k'o'ol tzex kolwaj t'a heb' meb'a'. Tato icha chi' scheklajeli to wach' ex t'a smasanil.

Ex fariseo, te chuk eyiko'. Ha ex tik tzeyak' sdiezmoal te' alawena yet' te' ruda. Jantaknhej juntzanh itaj, tzeyak'nhej sdiezmoal. Palta tze na to manh yowalilok tojol tzeyutej he b'a t'a anima. Malaj tze na' wach'chom manh xajanok Dios eyu'uj. Oktom a juntzanh tik tze b'eyb'alej, max eyaktejkan pax juntzanh chi'.

Ex fariseo, te chuk eyiko'. Ha t'a spatil culto, anhej t'a xila heb' niwak winak b'aj tze nib'ej tzex em k'ojan. Haxo yik tzex ek' t'a yol calle, tze nib'ej tz'em nhojan heb' anima t'ayex, ayik tzex sk'uman heb'.
Ob'iltak ex, lajan ex icha b'aj smukji heb' chamnak, manhxo chekelok b'aj mukan. Tz'ek' heb' anima t'a yib'anh, yujto manhxo chekelok tato ay anima mukan ta', xchi Jesús t'a heb'.
Ayik ix lajwi yalan juntzanh chi' Jesús, ay jun winh k'ayb'um t'a ley Moisés ix halan t'ay: --Ach ko k'ayb'umal, ayik tzalan juntzanh tik, te chuk pax skab' a onh tik, xchi winh.

Ix yalanpax Jesús t'a heb': --Ex k'ayb'um t'a ley Moisés, te chuk pax eyiko', yujto a juntzanh he leyal, lajan icha junok ikatz te al. Tonhej tze tusb'ejk'ei yik skuchan heb' anima, palta max eyak'och junok yiximal he k'ab' he t'unhanb'at t'a yib'anh heb'.
Palta chuk eyiko'. Tzato he wach' b'oej yet'tal heb' schekab' Dios t'a he kampusante, haton heb' milb'ilcham yuj heb' he mam eyicham.
Ayik tze b'oan juntzanh chi', tze ch'oxeli to wach' yutejnak sb'a heb' he mam eyicham chi' he na'ani. Ha heb' miljinakcham heb', a exxo tik, tzato he b'opaxk'e yet'tal heb' chi'.
Yuj chi' ix yalkan Dios yet' sjelanil: Ol in chekb'at juntzanh heb' in chekab' yalel in lolonel t'ayex. Ay heb' ol he milchamok, ay pax heb' tonhej ol eyak'och t'a sya'elal, xchi.
Yuj chi' t'a eyib'anh t'a jun pekti' tik ol yak'kan Dios masanil schamel heb' schekab' milb'ilcham yiktax ix el yich jun yol yib'anhk'inal tik.

Manh jantakok heb' schekab' Dios milb'ilchamok yiktax ix miljicham winhaj Abel, masanto ayik ix miljicham winhaj Zacarías t'a snanhal altar yet' stemplo Dios. Yuj chi' swal t'ayex to ha Dios ol ak'ankan schamel juntzanh heb' schekab' chi' t'a eyib'anh.

Ex k'ayb'um t'a ley Moisés, te chuk eyiko', yujto munil ix eyak'och eyopisio he jakan spensar heb' anima yet' slolonel Dios, palta max eyak'och he pensar t'a slolonel chi', haxo heb' snib'ej syak'och spensar t'ay, max he chalaj yak'och heb', xchi Jesús chi'.
Ayik ix yalan juntzanh chi', ix te kot yowal heb' winh k'ayb'um t'a ley chi' yet' heb' winh fariseo chi'. Ix och ijan heb' winh stzuntzan yuj juntzanh tas sk'anb'ej heb' winh t'ay.
Smaklej yab' heb' winh tato ay junok b'aj slektaj sloloni, yik syak'och heb' winh t'a yib'anh.

Ha junel smilalxo heb' anima ix smolb'ej sb'a t'a Jesús. Ix laj ste switz'ej sb'a heb', ix laj stek'laj yok heb'. Haxo Jesús chi' ix b'ab'laj halan t'a heb' sk'ayb'um: --Tzeyil wal he b'a t'a yich span heb' fariseo, syalelk'ochi, haton schab'satil heb',
yujto jantaknhej tas k'ub'anel tiknaik, ol laj cheklajelta. Yet' pax jantaknhej k'ub'eltak yaji, ol ojtakajelok.
Yuj chi' masanil tas tzeyal t'a k'ub'eltak, ol laj yab' heb' anima smasanil. Yet' pax masanil tastak slaj he sajlajoch t'a he chikin, ol laj pukaxel t'a skal heb' anima smasanil.
Swal t'ayex ex wamigo, manh ex xiw t'a heb' smilan he niwanil tik, yujto ayik slajwi ex smilan heb', malaj junokxo tas syal ex yutan heb'.
Palta swal t'ayex mach b'aj yowalil tzex xiwi: Xiwanhek t'a Dios. Haton jun syal yik'anel he k 'inal, slajwi chi' tzex yak'anb'at t'a infierno. Yuj chi' wal yel xiwanhek t'ay.
Ileknab' nok' kotak much, malaj yelk'och nok'. Ayik schonhchaj nok', owanh nok' t'a chab' kotak tumin, palta ha Dios max satlaj sk'o'ol t'a junok nok'.
Ha ex xo tik, ek'alto eyelk'och t'a yichanh jantak nok' yunetak much chi'. Inatax xil he jolom, b'isb'il yuj Dios chi'. Yuj chi' manh ex och ilk'olal.
Ha in swal t'ayex, yalnhej mach junok heb' tz'alan t'a yichanh heb' anima to wik heb', icha in pax ta', a in Ak'b'il in kot yuj Dios woch animail tik, ol wal heb' wikok t'a yichanh heb' yángel Dios.
Ha heb' tz'alan t'a yichanh heb' anima to manh wikok heb', a in xo ol wal pax el t'a yichanh heb' yángel Dios to manh wikok heb'.

Ha heb' tz'alan junok chukal t'a in patik, a in Ak'b'il in kot yuj Dios woch animail tik, syal yak'ji lajwok smul heb'. Haxo heb' tz'alan junok chukal t'a spatik Yespíritu Dios, a jun mul chi', manhxo ol ek'b'atlaj.
Ayik ol ex ik'jokb'at t'a spatil culto, ma tzex ik'jib'at t'a yichanh heb' winh juez, ma heb' winh yajal, manh eyak' pensar yuj tas ol eyutok he kolan he b'a t'a heb', ma yuj tas ol eyala',
yujto ayik ol k'och stiempoal eyalani, a Yespíritu Dios ol halan t'ayex tas ol eyala', xchi Jesús t'a heb'.
Ha t'a skal juntzanh anima chi', ay jun winh ix halan t'a Jesús: --Ach ko k'ayb'umal, al t'a winh wuk'tak to a tas aykan t'a winh yuj winh ko mam syak' nanhalok wik winh yet'ok, xchi winh.
Ix yalan Jesús t'a winh: --Ach wamigo, ¿tom ay mach ix ak'an wopisio woch juezal t'ayex, yik tzin pukanb'at juntzanh he k'a'el chi'? xchi t'a winh.

Ixlajwi chi', ix yalan t'a heb' anima: --Tzeyil he b'a, tze tanhwej wal he b'a, yik malaj b'aj ol eyil he k'o'ol t'a junok tas, yujto wach'chom tzijtum tas ay t'ayonh, manh yujok chi' tzalajk'olal tzonh ek' t'a yol yib'anhk'inal tik, xchi.
Yuj chi' ix yal jun ch'oxnab'il tik t'a heb': --Ay jun winh b'eyum, tzijtum sat tas syawej winh ix el t'a sat slu'um.
Ix snaub'tanhan winh: ¿Tas swutej? Manhxa b'aj syal in molankan sat tas ix wawej tik.
Ix sna'an winh icha tik: Ol in pojel juntzanh spatil sat wawb'en tik, ol in b'oan juntzanhokxo niwak. Hata' ol in molkanoch masanil tastak ix wawej yet' masanil in k'a'el.

Ol lajwok chi', ol walan icha tik: Ha tiknaik, niwan tas ix in molb'ejkani, niwan tiempo ol in k'ana', yuj chi' syal wik'an wip tiknaik, syal tzin wa'i, swuk'an ha', jantaknhej tas tzin nib'ej. Syal wak'an tzalajb'ok in k'o'ol, xin chama, xchi winh.
Palta ix yalan Dios t'a winh: Ha ach tik te malaj a pensar. T'a jun ak'wal tik ol ach chamok. Ha juntzanh molb'ilkan tik u'uj, ¿mach ay yiko'? xchi Dios t'a winh.
Icha chi' yaj heb' smolan sb'eyumal t'a yol yiko', haxo t'a yik Dios meb'a' heb', xchi Jesús t'a heb' anima.
Ixlajwi chi', ix yalan Jesús t'a heb' sk'ayb'um: --Swal t'ayex, manh eyak' pensar yuj tas ol ik'an yek' tiempo eyu'uj. Yuj tas tze wa''a yet' pax yuj he pichul tzeyak'ochi.
Ha Dios tz'ak'an ko k 'inal, okxom tas sko wa''a, ¿tom manh ol yak'a'? Ha ix ak'an ko niwanil, ¿tom manh ol yak' pax ko pichul?

Ina nok' much, ¿tom ay tas syawej nok'? ¿tom ay tas sjach' nok'? Malaj yet'tal b'aj smolb'ej jab'ok swa'el nok', palta ha Dios tz'ak'annhej tas swa nok'. Ha ex xo pax tik, ek'al eyelk'och t'a yichanh nok' much chi'.
¿Tom ay junok ex syal eyak'anoch nanhalokxo wara he te'el yujto tzeyak' pensar?
Yuj chi' tato max techaj he b'oan juntzanh tas malaj yelk'ochi, ¿tas yuj tzeyak' pensar yuj juntzanhokxo tasi?

Ilek nab' te' xumak sk'ib'i. Max munlaj te', max ch'alwi te'. Wach'chom icha chi', ayik yek'nak winhaj rey Salomón t'a peka', te wach' yilji winh yet' spichul, palta maj tzak'wan yilji winh icha te' xumak chi'.

Ha juntzanh te' chi', tonhej ayek' te' t'a kaltak te', haxo t'a junxo k'u snhusjitz'a te' t'a yol horno. Wach'chom icha chi' yaj te', ha Dios tz'ak'an swach'il yilji te'. Yuj chi' a ex tik, yelxo wal ol yak' he pichul Dios, palta a ex pural tzeyak'och t'a he k'o'ol.
Yuj chi' manh eyak' pensar yuj tas ol he wa''a, yet' yuj tas ol eyuk'ej.
Ha heb' manh ojtannakok Dios, haton t'a spatik juntzanh tik k'elanoch heb', palta yojtak Dios to ay tz'och juntzanh chi' ku'uj, yujto ko Mam yaji.
Yuj chi', ak'ek eyip he k'anab'ajan Dios Kajal. Tato icha chi' tze k'ulej, ol ak'jokpax masanil juntzanh chi' t'ayex.
Ha ex tik, icha in kalnel eyaji. Wach'chom jaywanh exnhej, palta manh ex och ilk'olal, yujto a ko Mam Dios ix ex ak'an och t'a yol sk'ab', yujto icha chi' ix el t'a sk'o'ol.

Chonhekkan el tastak ay t'ayex, ak'ek t'a heb' malaj yiko'. Icha chi' ol aj smolchaj he b'eyumal t'a satcha'anh, ichok t'a yol junok yet'tal malaj b'ak'inh ol k'aok. Ha jun chi' malaj b'ak'inh ol lajwok. Hata', malaj junok elk'um syal yelk'anelta. Hanhejtona', manh ol och pax ijaxok.
Ha b'aj ay ko b'eyumal, hata' ayb'at ko pensar.
Te lista tzeyutej he b'a icha heb' ayoch spichul, ay pax och scandil heb' stanhwani.

K'inalok ay heb' chekab' wan stanhwan sjax spatrón t'a junok k'inh nupnajel, sjax t'a spat. Ha sjawi, tz'awajochi, lista yaj heb' chekab' chi' sjakanoch t'a elanhchamel. Icha syutej sb'a heb' chekab' chi' stanhwani, icha chi' tzeyutej he b'a.
Tato pitzan heb' chekab' chi' ayik sjax spatrón heb' chi', te wach' yik heb'. Wal yel swal t'ayex to a wal winh patrón chi' sb'oanem k'ojjab' heb' t'a mexa, tz'ak'ji wa heb' yuj winh.
Wach'chom chimilak'walxo, ma ayto sk'ana', ta pitzan heb' schekab' chi', te wach' yik heb'.
Nachajokab'el jun ab'ix tik eyu'uj. K'inalok ay junok winh ix och elk'um t'a yol spat, tato yojtak winh jantak hora sk'och jun elk'um chi', majam scha jakjoklaj spat winh chi'.
Ha exxo pax tik, lista tzeyutej he b'a, tze maklani, yujto ayik manto in he na jawok, ol in ja juknaj a in Ak'b'il in kot yuj Dios woch animail tik, xchi Jesús t'a heb'.
Yuj chi' ix sk'anb'an winhaj Pedro t'ay: --Mamin, ¿ku'ujnhej a ma ix al jun ch'oxnab'il tik, ma yuj heb' anima smasanil? xchi winh.

Yuj chi' ix yalan Jesús t'a heb': --¿Mach heb' sch'ox heb' chekab' wach' chi' tze na'a? K'inalok ay junok patrón, tato ay junok chekab' sk'anab'ajani, jelan paxi, haton jun chi' tz'ak'jioch yopisio yoch mayordomoal yik syil heb' schekab' chi' smasanil, syak'an wa heb' t'a junjuntak el.
Tato a jun chekab' chi' wan smunlaj icha snib'ej spatrón, te wach' yiko' ayik ol jax spatrón chi'.
Wal yel swal t'ayex to ol yak'och winh yilumalok jantak tas ay t'ay.
Palta k'inalok a jun chekab' chi' sna'ani to manto ol ja spatrón chi', yuj chi' syamanoch smak'an heb' yetchekab'wumal chi' yet' heb' ix ix smunlaji, tonhej syak' snib'ej swa'i, syuk'an anh.

Haxo t'a junok k'u sna'a to manto ol jalaj winh spatrón chi', palta ha t'a jun k'u chi' ol jawok winh. Ta sjawi winh ayik manh tanhwab'ilok, manh na'anok yuj jun chekab' chi', te niwan sya'elal ol ak'jokoch t'a yib'anh. Ol yak'anb'at winh t'a skal heb' maj ak'an och Dios t'a sk'o'ol.
K'inalok ay junok chekab' ojtannak tas snib'ej spatrón t'ay. Palta manh listaok syutej sb'a, max sk'anab'ajej paxi. Te niwan ya'elal ol ochkan t'a yib'anh.

Palta k'inalok ay jun chekab' manh ojtannakok tas snib'ej spatrón, sk'ulej juntzanh tas smoj tz'ak'jikot ya'elal t'a yib'anh yuj, kennhej ya'elal chi' ol kot t'a yib'anh. Ha heb' niwan tas ix ak'ji t'ay, niwan pax tas ol k'anb'aj t'a heb'. Yet' heb' niwan tas ix ak'jioch t'a yol sk'ab', niwan pax tas ol yak'xi entregar heb'.
Ha in tik, in ja wak'och jun icha k'ak' t'a yol yib'anhk'inal tik. Komonok wal wanxo sk'e tinhton sk'ak'al tiknaik.
Ay wal jun niwan ya'elal ol ja t'a wib'anh, ichato ol in ak'jok bautizar yuj. Tzin kus wal sik'lab'il tiknaik masanto ol ujok elk'ochi.
¿Tom tze na a ex tik to in ja wak'och junk'olal t'a yol yib'anhk'inal tik? Swal eyab'i to ma'ay. In jawi wak' spoj sb'a heb' anima.
K'inalok ay owanhok t'a junok pat, ol och oxwanhok ajk'olal t'a chawanhxo. Haxo heb' chawanh chi' ol och ajk'olal pax t'a heb' oxwanh chi'. Icha chi' ol aj heb' anima t'a jun pekti' tik.
Ha heb' mamab'il, ol yak' owal heb' yet' heb' yuninal. Hanheja' pax heb' ix nunab'il, ol yak' owal heb' ix yet' yune'. Ay pax heb' ix alib'al ol yak' owal yet' heb' ix yalib', xchi Jesús t'a heb'.
Ix yalan juntzanhxo tik Jesús t'a heb' anima: --Ayik tzeyilan sk'e wa'an asun b'aj tz'em k'u, elanhchamel tzeyala' to ol yak' nhab'. Yel toni, icha chi' yaji.
Haxo yik skot ik' t'a sur, tzeyalani to ol k'ixnajok. Yel tzeyala', sk'ixnaji.
Palta a ex tik, chab' sat ex. Jelan snachajel juntzanh chi' eyu'uj, juntzanh skot t'a satcha'anh yet' t'a yol yib'anhk'inal tik, palta ¿tas yuj max nachajel eyu'uj tas syalelk'och jun pekti' tik?
¿Tas yuj max he b'eyk'olej he b'a tato tojol tas tze k'ulej t'a yichanh Dios?

K'inalok ay junok mach tz'ak'anoch tas t'a eyib'anh tiknaik, ayik wanto he b'at yet' t'a yol b'e, tzeyalan he b'a t'ay, yik maxtzak ex k'och t'a yichanh winh alkal. Yujto a winh alkal chi' ol ex ak'anoch t'a yol sk'ab' heb' winh polenkía. Haxo heb' winh ol ex ak'anoch t'a preso.
Swal t'ayex, max ex el t'a libre, masanto tze tup he multa smasanil.

Ha t'a jun pekti' chi', ay juntzanh heb' ix k'och t'a Jesús, ix yalan yab'ixal juntzanh heb' aj Galilea heb', chajtil ix yutej winhaj Pilato smilancham heb' ayik wan yak'an juntzanh silab' heb' t'a Dios.
Yuj chi' ix yalan Jesús t'a heb': --¿Tzam he na tas yuj icha chi' ix aj heb' winh aj Galilea chi'? ¿Yuj am to te chuk heb' winh t'a yichanh juntzanh heb' yetchonhab' chi' tze na'a?
Swal t'ayex to ma'ay. Ha ex tik, tato max he na he b'a yuj he mul, ol ex champax he masanil.

Naekkot yuj 18 heb' anima chamnak yuj jun pat te cha'anh ste'el lanhchajnak t'a Siloé. ¿Tas yuj icha chi' ajnak heb' tze na'a? ¿Tom te chuk heb' t'a yichanh juntzanhxo heb' yetchonhab' t'a Jerusalén chi'?
Swal t'ayex to ma'ay. Ha ex tik, tato max he na he b'a yuj he mul, he masanil ol ex champaxok, xchi Jesús t'a heb'.

Ixlajwi chi', ix yalan jun ab'ix tik t'a heb': --Ay jun winh awab'il jun te' higo yuj t'a sat slu'um. Ix b'at winh yila' tato ay sat te', palta haxo ix k'och winh, malaj junok sat te' ix ilchaj yuj winh.

Yuj chi' ix yalan winh t'a winh smunlaj t'a slu'um chi': Ina yoxilxo ab'il in kajwi wek' in say junok sat te', palta malaj junelok swil junok pitanh. Yuj chi' swal t'ayach, ch'akel te'. Nab'anhej tz'ixtax lum lum makb'il tik yuj te', xchi winh.
Haxo winh smunlaj chi' ix halani: Mamin patrón, tanhwej junokxo ab'il. Ol wak'lej in t'okan k'unb'ok lum t'a yich te', ol wak'an och abono t'a te',
talaj icha chi' ol yak' sat te'. Palta tato ma'ay, ol in ch'akanel te' icha tzal chi', xchi winh, xchi Jesús.
Ha t'a sk'uhal ik'oj ip ix k'och Jesús t'a yol spatil culto, yik sk'ayb'ej heb' anima.
Ayek' jun ix ix ta', 18 ab'ilxo yoch jun enemigo t'a ix. Ix koxob'ikan snanhal ix, toxonhej nhojanem ix. Maxtzak yal-laj stojolb'ik'e linhan ix.
Haxo yik ix ilchaj ix yuj Jesús, ix awtajkot ix yuj, ix yalan t'a ix: --Ach ix, toxo ach kolchaj t'a jun a ya'elal tik, xchi t'a ix.
Ix yak'anek' sk'ab' Jesús t'a yib'anh ix, wal t'a jun rato chi' ix tojolb'ik'e linhan ix. Ix och ijan ix yalan wach' lolonel t'a Dios.

Haxo winh yajal b'aj ayek' heb' chi', ix kot yowal winh yujto a Jesús ix ak'an b'oxok sk'ol jun ix ix chi' t'a sk'uhal ik'oj ip, yuj chi' ix yalan winh t'a heb' anima ayek' ta': --Wakenhej k'u smoj tzonh munlaj t'a yol semana. Ha t'a juntzanh k'uhal chi' syal tzex ja he k'an b'oxok he k'o'ol. Manhok t'a sk'uhal ik'oj ip, xchi winh yajal chi'.
Ix tak'wi Jesús t'a winh: --Ha ex tik, chab' sat ex. K'inalok ay junok nok' he wakax, ma junok nok' he b'uru etzan t'a sk'uhal ik'oj ip, ¿tom manh ol eyik'elta nok' yik b'at eyak'an yuk' ha' nok'?
Ha jun ix tik, yinhtilal Abraham ix. Ayxo 18 ab'il yamb'il ix yuj winh Satanás, ichato tzek'b'il ix yuj winh. ¿Tom manh smojok skolchaj ix t'a jun sya'elal tik yujto sk'uhal ik'oj ip? xchi Jesús.

Ayik ix yalan jun chi', masanil heb' ayoch ajk'olal t'ay, ix te k'ixwi heb'. Palta masanil juntzanhxo heb' anima, ix te tzalaj heb' yilan juntzanh tas ix sk'ulej Jesús chi', yujto te niwan yelk'och juntzanh milagro chi'.
Ix yalan Jesús: --¿Chajtil ol aj sk'ib' sb'isul heb' anima tz'och t'a yol sk'ab' Dios tze na'a? Ol wal jun ab'ix tik eyab'i yik ol nachajel eyu'uj.
Ha jun chi' lajan icha sat anh mostaza ix yawej jun winh t'a sat slu'um. Sk'ib' anh, lajan tz'aj anh yet' juntzanh te' niwak te'. Yuj chi' syal sway nok' much t'a sk'ab' anh, xchi Jesús.
Ix yalan junxo ab'ix Jesús: --Ol wal junxo ab'ix t'ayex chajtil ol aj sk'ib' sb'isul heb' anima tz'och t'a yol sk'ab' Dios.
Ha jun chi' lajan icha jab'ok yich pan syak'och jun ix ix t'a skal oxe' almul harina. Spajb'i masanil ixim yuj jab' yich pan chi', sipji ixim yuj, xchi Jesús.
Hanhejtona' wan sb'at Jesús t'a sb'e'al Jerusalén, ix laj ek' t'a juntzanh chonhab' yet' t'a juntzanh aldea b'aj ix sk'ayb'ej heb' anima.
Ay jun anima ix k'anb'an t'ay: --Mamin, ¿tom jaywannhej heb' ol kolchajok? xchi. Yuj chi' ix yalan Jesús:
--Hak'ek eyip eyoch t'a jun puerta yunenhej, yujto swal t'ayex to tzijtum heb' snib'ej yochi palta max yal-laj yoch heb'.

Ha in tik, icha yajal pat waji. Tato tzin k'e linhan tzin makan in pat yakb'an ayexto ek' t'a sti' te' pat chi', ol ex awajochok, Mamin, jak onh ochi, xe chama. Haxo ol walani: Manh wojtakok mach ex, xin chama.
Palta a onh tik wanak onh, kuk'nak ha' het'ok. Ha k'ayb'ejnak onh t'a yoltak calle, xe cham t'ayin.
Haxo ol walan t'ayex: Toxo ix wal t'ayex, manh ex wojtakok. Elanhek he masanil, yujto anhej chukal tze k'ulej, xin cham t'ayex.
Hato ta' ol ex sik'ik'ok eyok'i ayik ol heyilani, ayek' winhaj Abraham, winhaj Isaac, winhaj Jacob yet' smasanil heb' schekab' Dios ayxo ek' t'a yol sk'ab' Dios, a exxo tik, ayex kan elta t'a spatik.
Yujto ay heb' ol kot t'a junjun chonhab', b'aj sja k'u, b'aj tz'em k'u, t'a norte yet' t'a sur, ol em k'ojan heb' swa t'a smexa heb' ayxo och t'a yol sk'ab' Dios chi'.
Ay heb' malaj yelk'och tiknaik, haxo t'a jun pekti' chi' niwan ol aj yelk'och heb'. Ay pax heb' niwan yelk'och tiknaik, haxo t'a jun pekti' chi', malaj jab'ok ol aj yelk'och heb', xchi Jesús.
Hanheja' t'a jun k'u chi', ix k'och juntzanh heb' winh fariseo t'a Jesús, ix yalan heb' winh: --Elanh t'a tik, yujto snib'ej winhaj Herodes tzach smilchamok, xchi heb' winh t'ay.

Ix tak'wi Jesús chi' t'a heb' winh: --Ha winh chi', lajan winh icha nok' wa'ax, ¿tok ay yelk'och nok'? Ixikek, alek t'a winh: Ha tiknaik yet' k'ik'an swik'el heb' enemigo t'a heb' anima, ol laj b'oxok heb' pena'ay wu'uj. Haxo chab'ej tzin wach' b'oan in munlajel tik, xchi Jesús, xe chi t'a winh.
Palta a in tik, hanheja' ol in b'at tiknaik, k'ik'an yet' chab'ej, yujto anhej t'a Jerusalén tzonh miljicham a onh schekab' onh Dios tik.

Ha ex tik ex aj Jerusalén, chuk eyiko', tz'ok' wal in k'ol eyu'uj. Tze milnhejcham heb' schekab' Dios. Haxo juntzanhxo heb' schekjikot yuj Dios t'ayex, tonhej slaj he julcham heb' t'a k'e'en yax k'e'en. Tzijtum elxo in gana tzex wawtejkot t'ayin, icha junok nok' kaxlanh syawtejkot yune', smoyk'e t'a yalanh sk'axil, palta max yal he k'o'ol tzex koti.
Ab'ek. Ha jun he templo tik ol kan tzinan, yujto swal t'ayex to manhxo ol in eyil-laj, masanto ol eyal icha tik: Kalek wach' lolonel t'a jun chekb'ilkot yuj Dios Kajal, xe chama, xchi Jesús t'a heb'.
Ha t'a jun sk'uhal ik'oj ip, haton t'a sábado, ix k'och Jesús wa'el t'a spat jun winh yajal heb' winh fariseo. Haxo juntzanhxo heb' winh yetfariseoal winh ix maklan yila' tas ol yutej sb'a.
Hata' ayek' jun winh pena'ay yuj mal k'ab' ok t'a yichanh Jesús.

Haxo Jesús chi' ix k'anb'an t'a heb' winh k'ayb'um t'a ley Moisés yet' t'a heb' winh fariseo chi': --¿Ay am sleyal skak' b'oxok sk'ol junok pena'ay t'a sk'uhal ik'oj ip, mato ma'ay? xchi t'a heb' winh.
Manhxalaj tas ix yal heb' winh. Ichato chi' ix chaji winh pena'ay chi' yuj Jesús, ix b'oxi sk'o'ol winh yuj, ix yalan t'a winh to spax winh.

Ixlajwi chi', ix yalan t'a heb' winh fariseo chi': --K'inalok a ex tik ay junok eyuninal ma junok he wakax, sb'at t'a yol junok xab', ¿tom max b'at eyik'k'eta t'a elanhchamel, wach'chom sk'uhal ik'oj ip? xchi t'a heb' winh.
Majxo nachajlaj tas syutej heb' winh spakan t'ay.
Ix yilan Jesús tas ix yutej sb'a heb' awtab'il t'a jun wa'el. Snib'ej heb' tz'em k'ojjab' b'aj tz'em k'ojan heb' niwak winak. Yuj chi' ix yalan jun tik t'a heb':
--Tato ay b'aj tzex awtaj t'a junok k'inh nupnajel, manh ex em k'ojan t'a sk'ojnub' heb' niwak winak. Talaj icha chi' ay junok winh ek'al yelk'och t'ayex sk'och ta',
haxo winh tzex awtan chi' tz'alan t'ayex: Elanh t'a te' xila tik, ak'b'at te' t'a winh tik, tato xchi. Tzex k'ixwi, haxo t'a xila heb' malaj yelk'och tzex emkan k'ojan.

Palta ayik tzex awtaji, tzex em k'ojan b'aj malaj wal yelk'ochi, yik haxo sja winh tzex awtan chi', syalan winh t'ayex: Ach wamigo, ochanh t'a jun lugar b'aj tz'em k'ojan heb' niwak yelk'ochi, xcham winh. Ichato chi', niwan tz'aj eyelk'och t'a yichanh heb' ayek' t'a mexa chi'.
Yalnhej mach syik'cha'anh sb'a, ol ik'jok emta. Haxo heb' emnakil syutej sb'a, ol ik'jok cha'anh heb'.

Ix yalanpax t'a winh ix awtan heb' wa'el chi': --Ayik tza b'oan junok niwan wa'el, manh awtej heb' amigo, heb' uk'tak, heb' a k'ab' ok yet' heb' b'eyum t'a a lak'anil. Yujto ol ach yawtej pax heb' t'a yiko', icha chi' ol a cha'anxi spak chi'.
Palta ayik tza b'oan junok niwan wa'el, tzawtej heb' meb'a', heb' elnak sk'ab', heb' max uji sb'eyi yet' heb' max uji yilani.
Tato icha chi' tzutej, wach' ik syal chi', yujto wach'chom max a cha spak t'a heb', ol a cha spak ayik ol pitzwokxi heb' wach' sb'eyb'al, xchi Jesús t'a winh.
Ay jun winh ayoch t'a skal heb' ayoch t'a jun mexa chi', ayik ix yab'an juntzanh chi' winh, ix yalan winh t'a Jesús: --Te wach' yik heb' ol och wa'el b'aj ayoch Dios Yajalil, xchi winh.
Yuj chi' ix yal jun ab'ix tik Jesús: --Ha junel, ay jun winh ixb'o'an jun niwan wa'el. Tzijtum heb' anima ix yawtej winh.
Haxo ix k'och yorail jun wa'el chi', ix schekanb'at jun schekab' winh, ix b'at yalan t'a heb' awtab'il, ix yalan t'a heb': Kotanhek. Ix k'och yorail yoch wa'el, wach'xo yaj smasanil, xchi t'a heb'.

Palta ix laj sk'anan niwank'olal sb'a heb'. Ha jun winh b'ab'el, ix yal winh icha tik: Ay jun in lu'um toto ix in mana', yowalil b'at wila''. Swal in b'a t'ayach, ak'in niwank'olal, xa chi, xchi winh.
Haxo ix yalan junxo winh: Hato wal slajwi in manan oye' par in wakax tik, ol b'at wak'lej prowal nok'. Ak'ab' niwank'olal, xa chi t'a winh, xchi winh.
Ix yalan junxo winh: Toto ix och wetb'eyum, yuj chi' max yal-laj in b'ati, xa chi, xchi winh.

Yuj chi' a winh chekab' chi' ix halan juntzanh tik t'a spatrón. Ix kot yowal winh patrón chi', ix yalan winh icha tik: Ixik elanhchamel t'a yoltak calle t'a juntzanh b'e tzek' t'a kal chonhab' tik, tzik'kot heb' meb'a', heb' ay spaltail, heb' max uji sb'eyi yet' heb' max uji yilani, xchi winh.
Haxo ix k'ochxi winh schekab' chi' junelxo, ix yalan winh t'a winh: Mamin patrón, ix in k'anab'ajej tas ix ala', palta ayto sk'an sb'ut'ji, xchi winh.
Ix yalanxi winh t'a winh: Ixik t'a yoltak calle, t'a juntzanhxo b'e tzek' t'a yol chonhab' tik, tzak'an pural heb' skoti yik sb'ut'ji in pat tik yuj heb'.
Yujto swal t'ayach, malaj junok heb' ix in b'ab'laj awtej ol wa t'a jun niwan wa'el tik, xchi winh patrón chi', xchi Jesús.
Tzijtum heb' anima ix och tzak'an yuj Jesús, yuj chi' ix meltzajb'at k'elan t'a heb', ix yalani:

--Tato ay heb' sja t'ayin, palta ta más niwan yelk'och smam snun heb' t'a wichanh sna'ani, ma ix yetb'eyum, yuninal, heb' yuk'tak, heb' ix yanab', ma sk'inal heb', tato icha chi', max yal-laj yoch heb' in k'ayb'umok.
Ha heb' sb'eyb'alan in b'eyb'al, sb'ekanpax cham sb'a heb' t'a te' kulus wu'uj, anhej heb' smoj yoch in k'ayb'umok.
K'inalok ay junok ex tze nib'ej tze b'o junok niwan pat, ayik manto eyamoch he b'o'ani, ¿tom max ex em k'ojan tze na'an yuj stojol tato k'okb'il syab'i?
Tato ma'ay, tonhej tzeyak'kanem yich, haxo heb' anima tzex b'uchani.
Syalan heb': Ha jun winh tik, ix syamoch winh sb'o'an spat, palta maj b'olaj yuj winh, xcham heb'.

K'inalok ay junok winh rey wan sb'at yak' owal yet' junokxo winh rey, palta anhej lajunhe' mil soldado winh yet'nak. Haxo pax junxo winh rey chi', ay 20 mil soldado winh yet'nak. Ayik manto b'atlaj winh, ¿tom max em k'ojan winh sna'an sik'lab'il tato stechaj yak'an jun owal chi' winh?
Tato sna winh to max techaj yuj, schekanb'at junok schekab' winh t'a winh yet'nak syak'an owal chi', yakb'an najatto wan skot winh, yik syalan winh to tz'och heb' t'a junk'olal.
Ichex pax ta', tato max eyaktejkan jantak tas ay t'ayex, max yal eyoch in k'ayb'umok.
Ha atz'am atz'am, wach' ton atz'am. Palta k'inalok satel sk'achial atz'am, ¿tasto tz'aj sk'anchaji?
Manhxalaj tz'ochi, manhok t'a lum lum, manhok t'a abonoal, toxonhej syumchajeli. Ha juntzanh tzeyab' tik, naek wal sik'lab'il, xchi Jesús t'a heb'.
Masanil heb' winh tekumel alkabar yet' juntzanhxo heb' te chuk t'a yol sat heb' anima, ix k'och heb' t'a stz'ey Jesús smaklej yab' tas syala'.

Yuj chi' a heb' winh fariseo yet' heb' winh k'ayb'um t'a ley Moisés, b'uchumtak slolon heb' winh t'a spatik Jesús chi', ix yalan heb' winh: --Ha jun winh tik schanhej heb' chuk sb'eyb'al winh sk'och t'ay. Ina swa winh yet' heb', xchi heb' winh.
Yuj chi' ix yal jun ch'oxnab'il tik Jesús t'a heb' winh:

--K'inalok ay junok winh t'a he kal tik ay cienok nok' skalnel. Tato ay junok nok' satkani, skan nok' yetb'eyum nok' chi' t'a junok ak'lik, sb'at winh say nok' satkan chi', masanto schax nok' yuj winh.
Haxo schaxk'och nok' chi', schelankot nok' winh. Ste tzalaj wal winh.

Ayik sk'ochxi winh t'a spat, syawtankot heb' yamigo winh yet' heb' ay t'a slak'anil. Syalan winh t'a heb': Tzalajanhek wet'ok, yujto ix sat jun nok' in kalnel. Palta toxo ix ilchajxi nok' wu'uj, xchi winh t'a heb'.

Hanhejtona', k'inalok ay 99-ok anima, toxonton tojol spensar, manh yowalilok sna sb'a heb' sna'ani, malaj tzalajk'olal t'a satcha'anh yuj heb'. Palta a in swal t'ayex, tato ay junok malaj swach'il sb'eyb'al, sna sb'a yuj smul, yelxo wal niwan tzalajk'olal yuj jun chi' t'a satcha'anh.
K'inalok ay junok ix ix ay lajunheok stumin. Tato satb'at junok, syak'och staj ix, slaj smesanelta yol spat ix. Syak' wal snib'ej ix sayani masanto tz'ilchaji.

Haxo schax k'e'en yuj ix, smolb'an heb' ix swach'k'o'ol ix yet' heb' ay t'a slak'anil ix. Syalan ix t'a heb': Tzalajanhek wet'ok, yujto ay jun k'e'en in tumin ix sati. Haxo tiknaik, ix chax k'e'en wu'uj, xchi ix t'a heb'.
Wal yel swal t'ayex, icha pax chi' stzalaj Dios yet' heb' yángel t'a satcha'anh yuj junok anima chuk sb'eyb'al sna sb'a t'a smul, xchi Jesús.
Ix yalanpax junxo ab'ix tik Jesús: --Ay jun winh ay chawanh yuninal.

Ha winh tzak'an unin ix halan t'a winh smam icha tik: Mamin, pojkan snanhal tastak ol ak'kan t'ayonh hato syala' jantak ol ak' t'ayin, xchi winh. Yuj chi', a winh mamab'il chi' ix pojankan t'a heb' winh.
Jayeanto k'uhal chi', ix laj schonhanel tastak ix ak'jikan t'a winh yuj smam chi', ix b'at winh t'a junxo chonhab' te najat. Hata' ix b'at slajel stumin winh t'a juntzanh chukal.
Ayik toxo ix lajwiel k'e'en tumin chi', ix ja jun niwan wejel t'a jun chonhab' chi'. Manhxalaj tas swa winh, syak' wal techaj wejel winh.
Yuj chi' ix b'at sk'an munlaj sb'a winh t'a jun winh ay t'a chonhab' chi'. Haxo winh ix chekanb'at winh t'a jun slu'um tanhwoj chitam.
Scham winh yuj wejel, yuj chi' ix snib'ej winh yab'lej tas syab'lej nok' chitam chi', palta malaj mach tz'ak'an jab'ok tas t'a winh.
Ichato chi' ix sna'an sb'a winh: ¿Tas yuj icha tik tzin k'ulej, swak'cham in b'a yuj wejel t'a tik, axom t'a winh in mam jantak am tas swa heb' smajan winh, syak' sobre tas swa heb'?
Más wach' tzin pax b'aj ay winh in mam chi'. Ol walan t'a winh: Mamin, ix och in mul t'a Dios yet' t'ayach.
Manhxo in al uninalok. Ichokab' junok a majan tzin ajkani, xin chama, xchi winh.

Ix meltzaj winh b'i'an. Najatto wan skot winh, ix yilanb'at winh smam winh chi', ix te ok' sk'o'ol winh t'a winh. Ix b'at lemnaj winh schakot winh. Ix och lak'naj winh t'a winh, ix stz'ub'anelta sti' winh t'a tzalajk'olal.
Ix yalan winh t'a winh smam chi': Mamin, ix och in mul t'a Dios yet' t'ayach. Manhxo smojok tzin al uninalok, xchi winh.

Haxo winh mamab'il chi' ix halan t'a heb' smajan: Lemek, ik'ekkot jun mojok pichul te wach', tzeyak'anoch t'a winh wuninal tik. Tzeyak'anpax och junok kolk'ab' t'a sk'ab' winh, tzeyak'anoch xanhab' winh.
Slajwi chi', tzeyik'ankot junok nok' yune' wakax, haton nok' te b'ak'ech, tze milancham nok'. To ol och jun niwan wa'el, ol kak'anoch k'inh.
Yujto a winh wuninal tik, chamnakxo winh in na'ani, palta tob'an pitzan winh. Satnakb'at winh, haxo tiknaik ix jax winh t'ayin, xchi winh. Ichato chi', ix syamanoch heb' yak'anoch k'inh chi'.
Haxo winh b'ab'el unin, ayb'at winh t'a smunlajel. Haxo ix jax winh, ix yab'an winh ayoch son, wan yek' heb' chanhal.
Yuj chi' ix yawtankot jun smajan winh smam winh chi', ix sk'anb'an winh t'ay: ¿Tas yuj ayoch jun k'inh tik? xchi winh.
Yuj winh uk'tak ix jaxi. Ha winh a mam ix chekan miljokcham nok' yune' wakax b'ak'ech, yujto wach' sk'o'ol winh ix jax winh, malaj tas ix ik'an winh, xchi jun majan chi' t'a winh.
Yuj chi' ix kot yowal winh. Manhxalaj snib'ej winh yoch t'a yol pat. Yuj chi' ix elta winh smam winh chi', ix och ijan winh smontan winh yik tz'och winh.
Palta ix yalan winh t'a winh smam chi': Ojtak jantakxo tiempo tzin munlaji, malaj b'aj ix in pitej in b'a t'ayach. Manta b'aj tzak' junok nok' yune' chiwa yik swak'och in k'inh yet' heb' wamigo.
Haxo tiknaik ix jax winh uninal xit' satanel a tumin yet' heb' ix ajmul ix. Haxo yuj winh tza milancham nok' wakax b'ak'ech, xchi winh t'a winh smam chi'.
Haxo ix yalan winh smam winh chi': Ach wuninal, ay achnhej ek' wet'ok. Masanil tas ay t'ayin iknhej yaji.

Yuj chi' smoj ton kak'an och k'inh yik tzonh tzalaji. Yujto a winh uk'tak tik, chamnakxo winh ko na'ani, tob'an pitzan winh. Satnak b'at winh, palta ix jax winh t'ayin, xchi winh mamab'il chi', xchi Jesús.
Ix yalan jun ab'ix tik Jesús t'a heb' sk'ayb'um: --Ay jun winh patrón te b'eyum. Ay jun winh smayordomo winh. Ix yab'an spekal winh to a winh smayordomo winh chi' wan satanel tastak ay t'a winh.
Haxo winh patrón chi' ix awtan winh, ix yalan winh: Ay juntzanh tas ix wab' t'a a patik. Yuj chi' ak' entregar a cuenta t'ayin. Manhxo ol ach munlaj t'a jun opisio tik t'ayin, xchi winh.
Yuj chi' ix sna'an winh mayordomo chi', ¿tas ol wutok in b'a tiknaik? Ol in yik'el winh t'a wopisio, palta max uji junokxo munlajel wu'uj. Tzin k'ixwi wek' t'a titak pat in k'an wa in b'a.
Toxo ix in na tiknaik tas ol wutok in b'a. Yuj chi' wach'chom malaj in munlajel, tekan ay heb' ol in cha'anoch t'a yol spat, xchi winh.
Ixlajwi chi', ix laj yawtankot heb' winh ay sb'ok t'a winh spatrón winh chi'. Ix sk'anb'an winh t'a winh ix b'ab'lajk'ochi: ¿Jantak a b'ok t'a winh patrón? xchi winh.

Cien barril in b'ok aceite t'a winh, xchi winh. Hinye, tato icha chi' a b'ok aceite chi', ina jun yumal a b'ok chi'. Elanhchamel tzach em k'ojan, tza b'oan junokxo, 50-nhej tza tz'ib'ejemi, xchi winh mayordomo chi' t'a winh.

Ixlajwi chi', ix sk'anb'an winh t'a junxo winh: Xal ach, ¿jantak pax ik t'a winh? xchi winh. Ha in tik, cien quintal in b'ok trigo t'a winh, xchi junxo winh chi'. Tato icha chi', a tz'ajxikan t'a yumal a b'ok chi', 80-xonhej tza tz'ib'ejemi, xchi winh t'a winh.

Ix yalan winh patrón chi' to te jelan ix yutej sb'a jun winh mayordomo chi' t'a elk'al. Yujto a heb' ay t'a yol yib'anhk'inal tik, te jelan syutej sb'a heb' t'a yichanh heb' ayoch sakil k'inal Dios t'ay.

Ha in swal t'ayex, a k'e'en tumin, sekojtak sk'anji k'e'en t'a chukal. Palta wach' tzeyamk'ab'ej k'e'en t'a wach'il, yik tz'aj eyamigo. Tato icha chi', ayik ol lajwok yopisio k'e'en he tumin chi', ol ex chajok t'a jun eyet'tal ay t'a junelnhej.

Ha heb' tojol syutej sb'a yet' jab'ok tasi, hanhejtona' tojol pax syutej sb'a heb' t'a jantak tas niwan ay t'ay. Ha heb' manh tojolok syutej sb'a yet' jab'ok tasi, hanhejtona' manh tojolok ol yutok sb'a heb' yet' junok niwan ol ak'jok t'ay.
Yuj chi', tato manh tojolok tzeyutej he b'a yet' k'e'en tumin sk'anchaj t'a yol yib'anhk'inal tik, malaj mach ol ak'an junok b'eyumal niwan yelk'och t'a yol he k'ab'.
Tato manh tojolok tzeyutej he b'a t'a junok tas ch'ok mach ay yiko', malaj mach ol ak'an junok eyiko'.

Malaj junok mach syal yak'an serwil chawanhok spatrón, yujto ay jun malaj yelk'och t'ay. Haxo junxo te niwan yelk'och t'ay. Wach' syutej sb'a t'a junok, haxo t'a junxo chuk syutej sb'a. Max yal-laj kak'an serwil Dios yet' k'e'en tumin, xchi Jesús t'a heb'.
Haxo heb' winh fariseo, anhej t'a k'e'en tumin ayoch spensar heb' winh. Yuj chi', ayik ix yab'an jun chi' heb' winh, ix b'uchwaj heb' winh t'a Jesús.

Ix yalanxi Jesús chi' t'a heb' winh: --Ha ex pax tik, t'a yichanh heb' anima, wach' tzeyutej he b'a. Haxo pax Dios yojtak tas yaj he pensar. Ay juntzanh tas niwan yelk'och t'a yichanh heb' anima, haxo t'a yichanh Dios, chakb'ileli.

Anhej ley Moisés yet' juntzanh tas tz'ib'ab'ilkan yuj heb' schekab' Dios t'a peka' aykanoch yopisio masantax ix ulek' winhaj Juan winh ak'jinak bautizar. Haxo tiknaik, atax ix ulek' winh ix elkan yich yaljiel jun wach' ab'ix chajtil tz'aj yoch heb' anima t'a yol sk'ab' Dios. Yuj chi' masanil heb' syak' yip yoch t'a yol sk'ab' Dios.
Wach'chom ol lajwok ek' satcha'anh yet' yol yib'anhk'inal tik, haxo pax jun ley chi', wach'chom junok letra, malaj wal junok b'aj manh ol elk'och tas syala'.
Ha junok winh spuk sb'a yet' ix yetb'eyum, syik'an junokxo ix, tz'em winh ajmulal. Tato ay junok winh tz'ik'an pax junok ix spuknak sb'a yet' winh yetb'eyum chi', tz'empax winh ajmulal.
Ha junel ay jun winh te b'eyum. Wach' sb'o winh yet' spichul te caro stojol. Junjun k'u syak'an k'inh winh, tzijtum tas syak' chijok winh.
Ay pax jun winh meb'a' skuch Lázaro, ayk'e yab'il yaxk'a t'a winh. Tz'em k'ojan winh t'a sat lu'um t'a sti' spuertail spat winh b'eyum chi'.
Ha winh meb'a' chi', snib'ej winh swa jab'ok juntzanh sk'ajil wa'el tz'em t'a yalanh smexa winh b'eyum chi'. Haxo nok' tz'i' b'at lek'anel sat yab'il yaxk'a ayk'e chi' t'a winh.
Ix k'och sk'uhal ix cham winh meb'a' chi', haxo heb' ángel ix ik'anb'at winh t'a swach'ilal b'aj ayek' winhaj Abraham. Ix k'och pax sk'uhal ix cham winh b'eyum chi'. Ix mukchaj winh.
Ix k'och spixan winh b'aj ay spixan heb' chamnakxo. Haxo yik wan yab'an sya'il winh, ix k'e k'elan winh, najatto ix yilb'at winhaj Abraham chi' winh. Ayek' winhaj Lázaro t'a stz'ey winh.

Yuj chi' ix awaj winh b'eyum chi' icha tik: Mamin Abraham, ok'okab' a k'o'ol t'ayin. Chekkot winhaj Lázaro chi', sch'ayan yiximal sk'ab' winh, tzul yak'anoch winh t'a snhi' wak' yik siklab' jab'ok, yujto max techaj wab'an sya'il t'a kal k'ak' tik, xchi winh.

Haxo ix yalan winhaj Abraham chi': Ha ach tik, nakoti to te wach' ach ek' t'a yol yib'anhk'inal, haxo winhaj Lázaro tik, t'a sya'elal ix ek' winh. Ha tiknaik jun, wan scha'an sniwanil sk'ol winh t'a tik. Hanhejtona' ach, wan ab'an sya'il ta'.

Ha junxo swala', ay jun niwan xab' olan t'a ko kal heyet'ok. Yuj chi', wach'chom ay heb' ay t'a tik, snib'ej sk'axpaj ta', max yal-laj. Hanhejtona' ex, max yal-laj he k'axpajek' ta' t'a tik, xchi winh.
Tato icha chi' jun mamin, komonok tza chekb'at winhaj Lázaro chi' t'a spat winh in mam.
Hata' ay owanh heb' winh wuk'tak. Syalan winh yab' heb' winh yik wach' manh ol ja heb' winh wet' t'a skal ya'elal tik, xchi winh.
Ix yalan winhaj Abraham chi': Ha t'a heb' ayek' juntzanh tas stz'ib'ejnakkan Moisés yet' heb' schekab' Dios. Yak'okab'och heb' t'a sk'o'ol tas syal juntzanh chi', xchi winh.
Manh k'okb'ilok jun chi' mamin, palta tato ol pitzwokxi junok t'a skal heb' chamnak yal yab' heb', ol ton sna sb'a heb', xchi winh.

Ix yalanxi winhaj Abraham chi': Tato max yak'och sk'ol heb' t'a tas stz'ib'ejnakkan Moisés yet' heb' schekab' Dios chi', wach'chom ay junok ol pitzwok t'a skal heb' chamnak, hanhejtona' manh ol yak'och heb' t'a sk'o'ol, xchi winhaj Abraham chi' t'a winh, xchi Jesús.
Ix yalan Jesús t'a heb' sk'ayb'um: --Ay juntzanh tastak tz'ik'an somchajel spensar heb' anima, palta a wal mach tz'ak'an somchajel spensar heb' yetanimail, te chuk yiko'.
Oktom b'ab'el spixjioch junok niwakil k'e'en t'a sjaj, syumjikanb'at t'a yol ha' mar yik sjik' ha' schami, yakb'an manto yak' somchaj spensar junok uninto. Tato icha chi', te wach' yiko'.
Yuj chi' tzeyil wal he b'a. Tato ay junok eyetanimail tz'och smul t'ayex, tzeyal t'ay. Tato sna sb'a, tzeyak' niwank'olal.

Wach'chom ukel tz'och smul t'ayex t'a junok k'u, palta ukel sb'at yalxi sb'a t'ayex syalan icha tik: Hak'in niwank'olal, manhxo ol in k'ulej junelxo, tato xchi, yowalil tzeyak' niwank'olal, xchi Jesús.
Ha heb' schekab' Jesús ix halan t'ay: --Ochanh ket'ok yik sko wach' ak'ejoch Dios t'a ko k'o'ol, xchi heb'.

Yuj chi' ix yalan t'a heb': --Tato yel tzeyak'och Dios t'a he k'o'ol, wach'chom jab'nhej, icha kilan junok pitanh sat anh mostaza, ol yal eyalan t'a jun niwan te' tik: K'eanhkot yet' sch'anhal ib'. Tzach b'atkan t'a yol ha' mar. B'at awejempax a b'a ta', tato xe chi, ol sk'anab'ajej te' icha tzeyal chi'.

K'inalok ay junok ko chekab' tzonh ak'an serwil. Tato ayb'at t'a ko munlajel, mato ayb'at iloj kalnel, ma iloj wakax, haxo yik sjaxi, ¿tom na'an kalan t'ay? Ochanh, emanh k'ojan, wa''anh, ¿tom xko chi t'ay?
Ma'ay jun. Tekan icha tik skutej kalan t'ay: K'exel a b'a, b'ikel a k'ab'. Tza b'oan in wa'el, tzak'ankot t'ayin. Ichato chi' ol ach wa ach tik, xko chi t'ay.
¿Tom skak' yuj diosal t'ay yujnhej to ix sk'anab'ajej tas ix kal chi'? Ma'ay.

Icha jun chekab' chi', ichex ta'. Ayik toxo ix lajwi he k'anab'ajan masanil scheknab'il Dios, smoj tzeyal icha tik: Te malaj wach' kochi, anhej juntzanh tas ix chekji ko k'ulej ix ko b'o'o, xe chi, xchi Jesús t'a heb'.
Haxo Jesús, hanheja' sb'at t'a sb'e'al Jerusalén, ix k'och t'a smojonal Samaria yet' Galilea.
Ayik ix k'och t'a jun aldea, ay lajunhwanh heb' winh pena'ay yuj jun yab'il skuch lepra. Yuj chi' maj snitzochlaj sb'a heb' winh t'a stz'ey Jesús,
tonhej ix awajkot heb' winh t'ay: --Mamin Jesús, ok'ok wal a k'o'ol t'ayonh, xchikot heb' winh.
Haxo ix iljib'at heb' yuj Jesús, ix yalanb'at t'a heb': --Ixikek, ix ch'oxek he b'a t'a heb' sacerdote, xchi t'a heb' winh. Yakb'an wan sb'ey heb' winh, ipan sb'oxi heb' winh.
Ay jun winh t'a skal heb' winh chi', ayik ix yilan winh to toxo ix b'o sk'o'ol, ix meltzaj winh, ix och ijan winh yalan wach' lolonel t'a Dios, ix awaj wal cha'anh winh.
Ix jawi winh t'a yichanh Jesús, ix em kumnaj winh t'a sat lu'um yik syak'an yuj diosal winh t'ay. Aj Samaria jun winh chi'.
Yuj chi' ix yalan Jesús: --¿Tom manh lajunhwanhok heb' winh ix b'oxi sk'o'ol? ¿B'aj ay b'alunhwanhxo heb' winh chi'?
Ha jun winh tik, ch'ok chonhab'il winh, palta anhej winh ix ul halan wach' lolonel t'a Dios.
Ix yalan Jesús t'a winh: --K'e'anh wa'an, paxanh. Ach b'oxi yujto in ak'och t'a a k'o'ol, xchi t'a winh.
Ay juntzanh heb' winh fariseo ix k'anb'an t'a Jesús: --¿B'ak'inh wal ol och Dios Kajalok? xchi heb' winh t'ay. --Ayik ol och Dios Kajalok, max yal-laj kilan yet' ko sat.
Max yal-laj kalani: Ayek' t'a tik, ma ayek' t'a chi', manh xko chiok, yujto ha t'a ko pixan tz'och Yajalil, xchi Jesús t'a heb' winh.

Ixlajwi chi' ix yalan t'a heb' sk'ayb'um: --Ay wal jun pekti' ol jawok, ol eyalan icha tik: Tzok wal jax junelxo jun Ak'b'ilkot yuj Dios t'a ko kal tik, wach'chom junnhejlaj k'uhal, xe chama. Palta manhxo ol jalaj.
Ay heb' ol alanok: Ina yajek' t'a tik, ma ina yajek' t'a chi', xcham heb', palta manh ex b'atok, manh ex och tzak'an yuj heb'.
Yujto icha wal yek' kopnaj lheb'lon, sakb'i smasanil satcha'anh yuj, icha chi' ol aj in ja t'a jun k'uhal a in Ak'b'il in kot yuj Dios woch animail tik.
Palta yowalil ol in b'ab'laj ab'ej wal sya'il sik'lab'il. Ol in spatikejel heb' anima t'a jun pekti' tik.
Ayik ol in jaxok, lajan ol aj icha jun pekti' ayik yek'nak winhaj Noé.

Yujto a heb' anima t'a jun pekti' chi', ichnhejta' yek' k'u yuj heb': Swa heb', syuk'an ha' heb', ay heb' wan yoch yetb'eyum, ay heb' wan sk'anji yisil. Max snalaj heb' tato ay tas ol ja t'a yib'anh heb'. Icha chi' yek' tiempo yuj heb' masanto k'och sk'uhal yoch winhaj Noé chi' t'a yol te' arka. Haton ta' kotnak jun niwan ha' mukwajum, laj cham heb' smasanil.
Icha pax chi', ujinak t'a stiempoal pax winhaj Lot: Swa heb', syuk'an ha' heb', smanwaj heb', schonhwaj heb', syawej tastak heb', slaj sb'o'an spat heb'.
Ha wal yelkankot winhaj Lot t'a yol chonhab' Sodoma, yemul jun k'ak' yet' juntzanh kotak k'e'en chak xilinak. Icha wal yem nhab', icha chi' yemta t'a satcha'anh. Icha chi' aj scham heb' smasanil.
Icha wal ajnak t'a jun pekti' chi', icha chi' ol aj in ja a in tik, xchi Jesús.
Ha t'a jun k'uhal chi', tato ay heb' ayk'e t'a yib'anh spat, wach'chom ay tas aykan yuj heb' t'a yol spat, mokxob' emtalaj heb' yik'eli. Tato ay heb' ayb'at munlajel, mokxob' meltzaj heb' t'a spat.
Tze nakot tas ajnak ix yetb'eyum winhaj Lot chi'.
Ha heb' snib'ej skol sb'a t'a yol yib'anhk'inal tik, ol satel sk'inal heb' t'a junelnhej. Haxo heb' syak'cham sb'a wu'uj, ol scha sk'inal heb' t'a junelnhej.
Swal t'ayex, tato ay chawanhok waynak t'a sat sch'at t'a jun ak'wal chi', ay jun ol ik'jokb'atok, ay junxo ol kanok.
K'inalok ay chawanhok heb' ix wan smol cheni, jun ix ol ik'jokb'atok, haxo junxo ix ol kanok, xchi Jesús t'a heb' sk'ayb'um chi'.
Ayik ix yab'an jun chi' heb', ix sk'anb'an heb' t'ay: --¿B'ajtil ol ujok jun chi' Mamin? xchi heb'. --Icha tz'ajk'och nok' ostok b'aj ay junok chamnak nok', icha chi' ol ajok, xchi Jesús t'a heb'.
Ay jun ab'ix ix yal Jesús t'a heb' sk'ayb'um, yik snachajel yuj heb' to max yal stzaktzaj heb' yak'an lesal t'a masanil tiempo.
Icha tik ix yutej yalan t'a heb': --Ha junel ay jun winh juez t'a jun chonhab'. Malaj yelk'och Dios t'a sat winh. Malaj pax yelk'och heb' anima t'a winh.
Ha t'a jun chonhab' chi', ay jun ix chamnak yetb'eyum. Junjun k'u b'at sk'an ix t'a winh juez chi' to sb'o yaj yowal ix.
Te niwanxo tiempo tz'ek'i, malaj snib'ej winh juez chi' sb'o'an yaj t'a ix. Palta yib'anhtakilto ix sna'an winh: Wach'chom max in k'anab'ajej Dios, malaj pax tz'och heb' anima t'ayin,
palta a jun ix tik, ol in b'o yaj yowal ix, yujto junjun k'u tzul awaj ochta ix t'ayin. Tato ma'ay, manhxo ol techajlaj ix wu'uj, xchi winh.
Icha chi' ix yutej winh juez chuk chi' sna'ani.
Haxo pax Dios, ¿tom manh ol sb'o yaj t'a heb' sik'b'ilel yuj, heb' tz'awtan t'a k'uhal t'ak'wal? ¿Tom ol ek' tiempo skolwaj t'a heb' tze na'a?

Swal t'ayex, ol sb'o yaj t'a heb' t'a elanhchamel. Palta a in Ak'b'il in kot yuj Dios woch animail tik, ayik ol in jaxok, ¿ay am heb' aytoek' t'a yol yib'anhk'inal tik, hanheja' ayoch Dios t'a sk'o'ol? xchi Jesús Kajal.
Ix yalanxi junxo ab'ix tik Jesús t'a juntzanh heb' wach' spensar sna'ani. Ha t'a sat heb' chi', malaj swach'il juntzanhxo heb' anima. Yuj chi', icha tik ix aj yalan t'a heb':
--Ay chawanh heb' winh winak ix b'at lesal t'a yamak'il stemplo Dios. Ay jun winh fariseo, ay pax jun winh tekumel alkabar.

Ayik ix k'och winh fariseo chi', ix k'e linhan winh. Ix lesalwi winh icha tik: Ach in Diosal, swak' yuj diosal t'ayach, yujto manh in lajanok yet' juntzanhxo heb' anima. Ha heb' chi', elk'um heb', manh wach'ok syutej sb'a heb', tz'em heb' t'a ajmulal. Yet' pax jun winh tekumel alkabar tik, swak' yuj diosal t'ayach yujto manh in lajanok yet' winh.
Yujto a in tik, chael tzin och t'a tzek'ojk'olal t'a junjun semana. Hanhejtona' swak' sdiezmoal t'ayach yuj jantak tas swak' ganar, xchi winh.

Haxo pax winh tekumel alkabar chi', najatto ix kotkan linhan winh, yujto xiw winh, manh jab'ok ix k'e k'elan winh t'a satcha'anh. Ix smak' snhi' sk'ol winh, ix yalan winh icha tik: Ach in Diosal, ok'ok wal a k'o'ol t'ayin, te chuk in, xchi winh t'a Dios.

Ha in tik swala' to ayik ix pax winh tekumel alkabar chi', wach'xo winh t'a yichanh Dios. Haxo pax winh fariseo chi', manh wach'ok winh t'a yichanh Dios, yujto a heb' syik'cha'anh sb'a, ol ik'jokxiemta heb'. Haxo heb' syik'emta sb'a, niwan ol aj yelk'och heb', xchi Jesús.

Ay heb' mamab'il ix ik'ankot heb' yuninal t'a Jesús yik syak'ek' sk'ab' t'a yib'anh heb'. Ayik ix yilan heb' sk'ayb'um to icha chi', ix kot yowal heb' t'a heb' ix ik'ankot heb' chi', ix kachji heb' yuj heb'.

Haxo Jesús ix awtankot heb' sk'ayb'um chi', ix yalan t'a heb': --Chaekkot heb' unin t'ayin. Manh he kachoch wa'an heb', yujto anhej heb' lajan spensar icha heb' unin tik, anhej heb' ay yalan yik yoch t'a yol sk'ab' Dios.
Wal yel swal t'ayex, a heb' max cha'an Dios Yajalok icha syutej heb' unin scha'ani, malaj b'ak'inh ol och heb' t'a yol sk'ab', xchi Jesús.
Ay jun winh yajal t'a skal heb' ix k'anb'an t'a Jesús: --Ach wach' k'ayb'um, ¿tas wach' tzin k'ulej yik tzin cha'an in k 'inal t'a junelnhej? xchi winh.
--¿Tas yuj tzin al wach'il? Malaj junok mach wach', anhejton Dios wach'.

Ha ach tik, ojtak scheknab'il Dios syal icha tik: Manh ex em t'a ajmulal. Manh he milcham junok eyetanimail. Manh ex elk'anok. Manh eyak'och es t'a yib'anh junok eyetanimail. k'anab'ajejek he mam he nun, xchi Jesús t'a winh.
--Yiktax unin in, ix in k'anab'ajej masanil juntzanh cheknab'il tik, xchi winh t'ay.

--Palta ayto junxo a paltail. Ixik, chonhkanel masanil tastak ay t'ayach, tzak'an stojol t'a heb' meb'a', ichato chi' ol aj a b'eyumal t'a satcha'anh. Slajwi chi', tzach jaxi, tzach och in k'ayb'umok, xchi Jesús t'a winh.
Haxo ix yab'an juntzanh chi' winh, ix te kus winh, yujto te b'eyum winh.
Haxo ix yilan Jesús to ix te och winh ilk'olal, ix yalani: --Ay wal smay manh ol ochlaj heb' b'eyum t'a yol sk'ab' Dios.
K'inalok ay junok nok' camello, ¿tom ol yal yek' nok' t'a yixal junok k'e'en akxa? Icha chi' yaj heb' b'eyum. Tato ol och heb', pural ol och heb' t'a yol sk'ab' Dios, xchi Jesús t'a heb'.
Haxo heb' ix ab'an jun chi' ix yalan heb': --A... tato icha chi' jun, ¿mach pax heb' ol kolchajok? xchi heb'.
--Ha tas max yal-laj yuj heb' anima, haxo Dios masanil syal yuj, xchi Jesús t'a heb'.
Haxo winhaj Pedro ix halan t'ay: --Mamin, a onh tik ix kaktejkan juntzanh tastak yik tzonh och a k'ayb'umok, xchi winh.
Yuj chi' ix yalan Jesús t'a heb': --Wal yel swal t'ayex, a heb' syaktejkan spat, ma smam snun, yuk'tak, yanab', ix yetb'eyum, yuninal yet' yisil yujto haxonhej Dios snib'ej heb' syak' serwil,
niwan spak ol scha heb' t'a jun pekti' tik, haxo t'a junxo tiempoal ol jawok, ol scha sk'inal heb' t'a junelnhej, xchi Jesús t'a heb'.

Ha Jesús ix awtankot heb' lajchawanh chi' sch'okojil, ix yalan t'a heb': --Ha tiknaik wan ko b'at t'a Jerusalén. Hata' ol ujok elk'och jantaknhej tas tz'ib'ab'ilkan yuj heb' schekab' Dios t'a peka' yik yalannakkan wab'ixal heb', a in Ak'b'il in kot yuj Dios woch animail tik.
Hata' ol in ak'jokoch t'a yol sk'ab' heb' ch'ok chonhab'il. Ol in sb'uch heb'. Ol laj yal chuk heb' t'ayin. Ol in stzub'ej heb'.
Ol in smak' heb'. Slajwi chi', ol in smilancham heb'. Haxo t'a schab'jial, ol in pitzwokxi, xchi Jesús t'a heb'.
Palta maj nachajel-laj jab'ok yuj heb'. Manh yojtakoklaj heb' tas wan yalan chi', yujto max nachajel-laj yuj heb'.
Ayik wanxo sk'och Jesús t'a chonhab' Jericó, ay jun winh max uji yilani, k'ojan ek' winh t'a ti' b'e, wan sk'anan stumin winh.
Ix yab'an winh to tzijtum anima wan yek' t'a yol b'e chi', yuj chi' ix sk'anb'an yab' winh tas wan yuji.
Ix yalan heb' t'a winh to a Jesús aj Nazaret wan yek' t'a yol b'e chi'.
Yuj chi', ix awajk'e winh, ix yalan winh: --Jesús, yinhtil ach kan winhaj David, ok'ok wal a k'ol t'ayin, xchi winh.
Ha heb' b'ab'el sb'at chi' ix kachan winh yik tz'em numan winh. Palta masnhej ix awajk'e winh: --Ach yinhtilalkan winhaj David, ok'ok wal a k'ol t'ayin, xchi winh.
Yuj chi', ix och tek'naj Jesús chi', ix schekan ik'jokkot winh. Haxo yik ix ja winh t'a slak'anil, ix sk'anb'an t'a winh:
--¿Tas a gana tzach wutej? xchi t'a winh. --Mamin, in gana sb'oxikan wilani, xchi winh.
--B'o'okab'xikan hilani. Tzach b'oxikani yujto in ak'och t'a a k'o'ol, xchi Jesús t'a winh.
T'a jun rato chi', ix b'oxikan yilan winh, ix och tzak'an winh yuj Jesús. Ix yalan wach' lolonel winh t'a Dios. Hanhejtona', a jantak heb' ix ilan jun chi', ix yal pax wach' lolonel heb' t'a Dios.
Ix k'och Jesús t'a Jericó, ix ek' t'a yol chonhab' chi'.
Hata' ay jun winh b'eyum skuchan Zaqueo. Yajal yaj winh t'a heb' tekumel alkabar t'a jun chonhab' chi'.
Snib'ej winh yilani chajtil yilji Jesús. Palta max yal-laj yilan winh, yujto tzijtum anima oyanoch t'a spatik Jesús chi' ayik wan sb'eyi, yujto tzapan pax ste'el winh.
Ix b'ab'lajb'at lemnaj winh, ix k'e winh t'a sk'ab' jun te te' ayek' t'a ti' b'e, yik syil winh yek' Jesús chi'.
Haxo yik ix ek' Jesús chi' ta', ix k'e k'elnaj t'a winh, ix yalan t'a winh: --Zaqueo, emanhkot elanhchamel, yujto a tiknaik ha t'a a pat ol wak' in posado, xchi t'a winh.
Ayik ix yab'an winh icha chi', elanhchamel ix emta winh. Haxo ix k'och Jesús chi' t'a spat winh, ix scha winh t'a tzalajk'olal.
Haxo masanil heb' anima, manh jantakok ix yal heb' t'a spatik Jesús, yujto ix k'och yak' sposado t'a spat jun winh chuk sb'eyb'al chi'.

Haxo winhaj Zaqueo chi' ix k'e linhan, ix yalan winh t'a Jesús Kajal: --Ha tiknaik Mamin, a jantak tas ay t'ayin, chapoj ol wutok. Ol wak' junok makan t'a heb' meb'a'. Tato ay mach ix laj wixtej, ix welk'ej, chanhel ol wak'pax sk'exul t'a heb', xchi winh.
Yuj chi' ix yalan Jesús chi': --Ha tiknaik, ix cha skolnab'il winh aj pat tik, yujto wal yel yinhtilalpaxkan Abraham winh.
Ha in Ak'b'il in kot yuj Dios woch animail tik, in jawi in say heb' satnak yik tzin kolanel heb', xchi Jesús chi'.

Yakb'an wan yab'an heb' anima tas ix yal Jesús chi', ay jun ab'ix ix yal t'a heb', yujto wan sk'och heb' t'a slak'anil Jerusalén. Ha sna'an heb' to toxo ol wach' och Dios Yajalil t'a yol yib'anhk'inal tik.
Icha tik ix yutej yalan t'a heb': --Ha junel ay jun winh winak yinhtilkan heb' niwak yelk'ochi. Ix b'at winh t'a jun chonhab' te najat, yik tz'ak'jioch winh reyal t'a schonhab'.

Ayik manto b'at winh, ix yawtankot lajunhwanh heb' schekab' winh. Ix yak'an juntzanh k'e'en tumin winh t'a heb'. Niwak sat k'e'en. Jun lajan k'e'en ix scha junjun heb'. Ix yalan winh t'a heb': Hak'ek he negocio yet' k'e'en tumin tik, masanto ol in jaxok, ichato chi' ol eyak'anxi k'e'en t'ayin, xchi winh t'a heb'. Ix b'at winh b'i'an.

Haxo heb' yetchonhab' winh, ix te chichon sk'o'ol heb' t'a winh. Ix schekanb'at jaywanh winak heb' t'a spatik winh, yik syalan heb': Ha jun winh tik, malaj ko gana tz'och winh reyal t'a ko chonhab' tik, xchi heb'.

Wach'chom icha chi' ix yal heb', ix ochnhej winh t'a yopisio chi'. Haxo yik ix jax winh, ix laj yawtankot heb' schekab' winh chi', machtak heb' b'aj yak'nakkan k'e'en tumin chi' winh, yik syab' winh jantakxo yune' k'e'en ix yak' ganar junjun heb'.
Ix b'ab'laj k'och jun t'a winh, ix yalani: Mamin patrón, a k'e'en tumin ak'nakkan t'ayin, lajunhexo yune' k'e'en ix yak' ganar, xchi t'a winh.

Haxo ix yalan winh yajal chi': Wach' jun. Ha ach tik, te wach' ach t'ayin. Wach'chom kennhej ix wak' t'ayach, palta wach' ix utej a b'a yet'ok. Yuj chi', swak'och opisio och yajalil t'a lajunheok chonhab', xchi winh t'ay.
Ixlajwi chi', ix k'och junxo schekab' winh chi'. Mamin patrón, a k'e'en a tumin ak'nakkan t'ayin, oyexo yune' k'e'en ix yak' ganar, xchi.
Yuj chi' ix yalanxi winh: Wach' jun. Yuj chi' ol ach wak'och yajalil t'a oye' chonhab', xchi winh.
Ixlajwi chi', ix k'och junxo schekab' winh chi', ix yalan t'a winh: Patrón, ina k'e'en a tumin tik. Sik'b'ilb'at k'e'en wu'uj t'a yol jun in payu'.
Ha in tik tzin xiwi, yujto wojtak ach to junnhej b'elanh ach, yujto a ach tik, toxonhej tza cha ikej tas syak' ganar junxo anima. Toxonhej tza jach'a', palta malaj tas tzawej, xchi t'a winh.

Yuj chi' ix yalan winh yajal chi': Ha ach tik wach'chom in chekab' ach, palta te chuk ach. Yuj juntzanh tzal tik, swak'kanb'at t'a ib'anh. Yujto a ach wal tzala' to junnhej b'elanh in. Toxonhej tzin cha wikej tas syak' ganar junxo anima. Toxonhej tzin jach'a', palta malaj tas swawej.
Tato icha chi' tzutej a na'an t'a wib'anh, ¿tas yuj maj ak'b'at k'e'en majanil t'a junokxo, haxo tzin jax tik tzin cha'anxi k'e'en yet' yune'? xchi winh t'ay.
Ixlajwi chi' ix yalan t'a heb' ayek' yet' chi': Ik'ek ek' k'e'en t'a winh, tzeyak'an k'e'en t'a winh ix ak'an ganar lajunhe' yune' yiko', xchi winh t'a heb'.
Haxo ix yalan heb': Palta mamin patrón, lajunhexo k'e'en ay t'a winh, xchi heb'.
Palta swal t'ayex, a mach ayxo yiko', ol wach' ak'jok nanhalokxo t'ay. Haxo heb' malaj yiko', ol wach' ik'jokek' tas ay t'a heb'.
Yet' pax heb' wajk'o'ol, heb' malaj snib'ej tzin och yajalil, ik'ekkot heb'. Milekcham heb' t'a wichanh tik, xchi winh yajal chi', xchi Jesús.
Ixlajwi yalan jun ab'ix chi' Jesús, ix scha'an pax sb'e, ix b'ab'laj yuj heb' sk'ayb'um yik sk'e heb' t'a Jerusalén.
Ayik wan sk'och Jesús chi' yet' heb' t'a slak'anil Betfagé yet' Betania, t'a yichanhb'at tzalan Olivo t'a slak'anil Jerusalén, ix schekanb'at chawanh heb' sk'ayb'um.
Ayik manto b'at heb', ix yalan t'a heb': --Ixikek t'a jun chonhab' t'a kichanhb'at tik. Hata' ol eyil jun nok' b'uru, etzanoch nok'. Mantalaj mach sk'e t'a yib'anh nok'. Tze tijankot nok'.
Tato ay mach tz'alan t'ayex: ¿Tas yuj tze tijelta nok'? ta xchi heb', tzeyalan t'a heb': Ha Kajalil ay tz'och nok' yuj, xe chi, xchi Jesús chi' t'a heb' winh.
Ixlajwi chi', ix b'at heb' sk'ayb'um chi'. Icha ix yutej yalan Jesús chi' t'a heb', icha chi' ix aj yilchaj nok' b'uru chi' yuj heb'.
Haxo yik wan stijanelta nok' heb', ix k'och heb' aj b'uru chi', ix yalan heb': --¿Tas yuj tze tijelta nok'? xchi heb'.
--To ay ol och nok' yuj Kajalil, xchi heb'.
Ixlajwi chi', ix yik'anb'at nok' heb' t'a Jesús chi'. Ix yak'anoch spichul heb' stz'amok nok', ix yak'ank'e Jesús chi' heb' t'a yib'anh nok'.
Haxo yik wan sb'eyi, ay heb' ix laj lich'anem spichul t'a yol b'e t'a yichanh b'aj sb'eyb'at chi'.

Haxo yik wan sk'och heb' t'a jun b'e spichlaj em t'a tzalan Olivo, a jantak heb' sk'ayb'um, ix laj och ijan heb' yawajk'e yuj tzalajk'olal. Ix laj yalan wach' lolonel heb' t'a Dios yuj juntzanh milagro ix yil heb'.
Ix laj yalan heb' icha tik: --Kalek wach' lolonel t'a ko reyal chekb'ilkot yuj Dios Kajal. Te ay junk'olal t'a satcha'anh, te niwan yelk'och ko Diosal ta', xchi heb'.
Ay juntzanh heb' winh fariseo ayek' t'a skal heb' anima chi' ix halan t'a Jesús chi': --Ach k'ayb'um, ¿tas yuj max a kach heb' a k'ayb'um tik? xchi heb' winh.
Yuj chi' ix yalan Jesús t'a heb' winh: --Swal t'ayex tato tz'em numan heb', haxo juntzanh k'e'en k'e'en tik ol awajk'eok, xchi t'a heb'.
Haxo yik wan sk'och Jesús t'a Jerusalén, ix yilanb'at jun chonhab' chi', ix ok' yuj.
Ix yalani: --Ex aj Jerusalén, oktom wal snachajel eyu'uj t'a jun k'u tik chajtil tz'aj he cha'an sjunk'olal Dios, palta a tiknaik, maxtzak yal-laj snachajel eyu'uj, yujto toxo ix k'ub'chajel t'ayex.
Yuj chi' ay jun pekti' ol ja t'a eyib'anh, a heb' eyajk'o'ol, ol och hoyan heb' t'a spatik yichanh he chonhab' tik. Ol laj yoyan sb'a heb' t'a he patik, ol yak'an owal heb' heyet'ok.

Ol laj smak'em weknaj jun chonhab' tik heb' t'a sat lu'um. Ol smilancham heb' anima chi' heb'. Haxo k'e'en k'e'en latz'b'ilk'ei, manhxa junok k'e'en ol kan t'a yib'anh k'e'en yetk'enal chi'. Ha jun tik ol ja t'a eyib'anh yujto ha t'a jun pekti' tik ix ja Dios t'ayex, palta max nachajel eyu'uj, xchi Jesús.
Ixlajwi chi' ix k'och Jesús t'a yol yamak'il stemplo Dios. Ix spechanelta heb' schonhwaji yet' heb' smanwaji.

Ix yalan t'a heb': --Tz'ib'ab'ilkan t'a Slolonel Dios icha tik: Ha in pat, yiknhej lesal yaji, xchi. Ha exxo tik, icha junok k'e'en nhak'e'en b'aj sk'ub'ejel sb'a heb' elk'um, icha chi' tzeyutej, xchi t'a heb'.

Junjun k'u ix k'och Jesús chi' sk'ayb'ej anima t'a yamak'il stemplo Dios chi'. Haxo heb' winh sacerdote, heb' winh k'ayb'um t'a ley Moisés yet' heb' winh yajalil jun chonhab' chi', ix say heb' winh tas syutej heb' winh smilanchamok.
Palta maj yal-laj yuj heb' winh, yujto ayoch t'a sk'o'ol heb' anima smaklan yab' t'ay.

T'a jun k'u chi' ix k'ayb'aj heb' anima t'a yamak'il stemplo Dios yuj Jesús. Ix yalan wach' ab'ix yik kolnab'il t'a heb'. Ix k'och heb' winh sacerdote, heb' winh k'ayb'um t'a ley Moisés yet' heb' winh ichamtak winak ay yopisio.
Ix yalan heb' winh t'a Jesús chi': --Al t'ayonh, tas aji, yuj chi' tza k'ulej juntzanh chi', ¿mach ak'jinak opisio chi'? xchi heb' winh t'ay.
--Ay pax jun tas tzin k'anb'ej t'ayex. Alek t'ayin,
¿mach ak'jinak yopisio winhaj Juan ayik ix yak'an bautizar heb' ix laj k'och t'a winh? ¿Am Dios ak'jinak, mato anima? xchi Jesús chi' t'a heb' winh.
Ix yal-lan yab' heb' winh: --¿Tas skutej ko pakan t'a winh? Tato skala' to ha Dios ix ak'ankot winhaj Juan chi', axom ol yalan winh: ¿Tas yuj maj eyak'och t'a he k'ol jun? xcham winh.
Palta tato skala' to yik heb' anima, axom heb' anima ol onh sjulk'enejcham heb', yujto a winhaj Juan chi', schekab' ton Dios yaj winh t'a yichanh heb', xchi heb' winh.
Yuj chi' ix yalan heb' winh to manh yojtakok heb' mach ak'jinak yopisio winhaj Juan chi'.
Ix yalan Jesús chi' t'a heb' winh: --Tato icha chi', manh ol walpaxlaj t'ayex mach ak'jinak wopisio yik tzin k'ulan juntzanh tik, xchi t'a heb' winh.

Ixlajwi chi', ix yalan jun ab'ix tik Jesús t'a heb' ayek' chi' ta': --Ay jun winh ix awan juntzanh te' uwa t'a sat slu'um. Ixlajwi chi', ix yak'ankanb'at slu'um winh chi' majanil yet' masanil yawb'en te' chi'. Ixlajwi chi', niwan tiempo ix b'atkan winh.

Haxo yik ix k'och stiempoal smoljiel sat te' uwa chi', ix schekb'at jun schekab' winh yik sk'anan smajananub'al lu'um. Haxo heb' ix majnan lu'um chi' ix mak'ani, ix spechan meltzaj heb', malaj jab'ok tas ix yak' heb' t'ay.
Yuj chi' ix schekb'at junxo schekab' winh aj lu'um chi'. Palta hanheja' ix stumej heb', ix smak'an pax heb', ix spechan meltzaj heb', malaj jab'ok tas ix yak' heb' t'ay.
Ix schekanxib'at junxo schekab' winh, haxo heb' ix majnan lu'um chi' ix mak'ani, ix spechan meltzaj heb'.
Haxo ix sna'an winh aj lu'um chi': ¿Tas tzin k'ulej tiknaik? Ol in chekb'at jun wuninal te xajan wu'uj. Tekan ol xiw heb' t'ay, xchi winh.

Haxo ix k'och winh uninab'il chi', ix slajtian sb'a heb' majnum lu'um chi'. Ix yalan heb': Ina sja winh uninab'il b'aj ol kan lum lum tik. Ko mak'ekcham winh, yik wach' a onhxo ol kikejkan lu'um, xchi heb'.
Yuj chi', ix snheranel winh heb' t'a stiel awb'en chi', ix smak'ancham winh heb'. Tzin k'anb'ej t'ayex, ¿tas ol utaj heb' majnum lum chi' yuj winh aj lu'um chi' tze na'a?

Haxo lak'an winh ol b'atok. Ol b'at smak'ancham juntzanh heb' majnum lu'um chi' winh. Ol yak'anxikanb'at lu'um winh majanil t'a juntzanhxo, xchi Jesús t'a heb' winh. Ayik ix yab'an jun tik heb' anima, ix yalan heb': --Komonok malaj b'ak'inh ol ujok icha chi', xchi heb'.

Haxo Jesús ix och k'elan t'a heb', ix yalani: --Tato icha chi', ¿tas syalelk'och juntzanh tas tz'ib'ab'ilkan t'a Slolonel Dios tze na'a? Syal icha tik: Ha jun k'e'en k'e'en malaj yelk'och t'a yichanh heb' b'o'um pat, haton k'e'en ix ochkan sjolomok schikin te' pat chi', xchikani.
Tato ay junok mach tz'em tanhnaj t'a yib'anh jun k'e'en chi', chok' tz'aji. Tato a k'e'en tz'em tanhnaj t'a yib'anh junokxo, icha pokok tz'aji, xchi Jesús t'a heb'.

Ha heb' winh sat sacerdote yet' heb' winh k'ayb'um t'a ley Moisés, ix snib'ej heb' winh syam Jesús t'a elanhchamel, yujto ix snael heb' winh to a heb' winh wan yalani, palta ix xiw heb' winh t'a heb' anima.

Yuj chi' ix chekjib'at jaywanh heb' winh yila' talaj tz'och smul Jesús chi'. Ha ix k'och heb' winh, wach' ix yutej sb'a heb' winh t'a yichanh Jesús chi'. Ix stz'akan sk'umej heb' winh yik slektaj t'a slolonel, yik syak'anoch heb' winh t'a yol sk'ab' heb' winh yajal.

Yuj chi' ix stz'ak sk'anb'ej heb' winh t'ay: --Mamin k'ayb'um, kojtak to tojol tzutej a loloni yet' pax onh a k'ayb'ani. Manhoklaj yilji anima tzila', yujto lajannhej yelk'och junjun anima t'ayach. Kojtak paxi to tzonh a k'ayb'ej t'a tas snib'ej Dios t'a wal yel.
Yuj chi' al t'ayonh: ¿Tom wach' skak' juntzanh tumin sk'anjiel t'ayonh yuj winh yajal t'a Roma, mato ma'ay? xchi heb' winh t'ay.
Ix snael Jesús to chuk spensar heb' winh sk'anb'an heb' winh. Yuj chi' ix yalan t'a heb' winh:
--Ch'oxek junok tumin chi' wila''. ¿Mach jun ayoch sat tik yet' sb'i tik t'a k'e'en? xchi t'a heb' winh. --Haton sat winh yajal t'a Roma yet' sb'i winh, xchi heb' winh.
Yuj chi', ix yalan t'a heb' winh: --Ha tas yiktaxon winh yajal chi' yaji, ak'ek t'a winh. Palta a tas yiktaxon Dios yaji, ak'ek t'a Dios chi', xchi t'a heb' winh.
Malaj junok tas ix yal chi' b'aj ix ak'ji ganar yuj heb' yik syaman heb'. Ix te sat sk'o'ol heb' yab'an tas ix spak chi', manhxalaj tas ix yal heb'.
Ixlajwi chi', ay juntzanh heb' winh saduceo ix k'och t'a Jesús. Haton heb' winh tik tz'alani to manh ol pitzwokxi heb' chamnak, yuj chi' ix yalan heb' winh t'ay:

--Mamin k'ayb'um, a winhaj Moisés tz'ib'annakkan icha tik: Tato ay junok winh winak schami, skan ix yetb'eyum winh, palta malaj yuninal winh skani, tato icha chi', haxo winh yuk'tak winh, tz'ik'anpaxkan ix ix chi', yik wach' tato tz'aj yuninal heb', ichato a winh ix cham chi' ay yiko'. Icha chi' ix yalkan winhaj Moisés chi'.
Ha junel ay ukwanh heb' winh yuk'tak sb'a. Ha winh b'ab'el winak ik'an jun ix ix, palta cham winh, malaj yuninal heb' kani.
Haxo junxo yuk'tak winh ik'anxikan ix. Palta cham junxo winh chi'. Malaj yuninal heb' kanxi.
Slajwi chi', haxo winh yoxil ik'anxi ix. Hanhejtona' yik'nak ix heb' winh yukwanhil. Cham heb' winh smasanil. Malaj junok heb' winh elkan yuninal yet' ix.
Haxo t'a slajwub'xo, scham ix.
Haxo ol pitzwokxi heb' chamnak, ¿mach junok heb' winh ol ik'an ix yujto yik'nak ix heb' winh yukwanhil? xchi heb' winh.
Yuj chi' ix yalan Jesús t'a heb' winh saduceo chi': --Ha t'a yol yib'anhk'inal tik, syik'laj sb'a heb' anima.
Palta ay wal junxo lugar. Ha heb' ol pitzwokxi t'a skal heb' chamnak, heb' smoj sk'ochkan ta', hata' manhxalaj ik'lajb'ail. Manhxo ol yak'b'at yisil heb' k'anjok.
Yujto ha t'a jun pekti' chi', manhxo ol chamlaj heb'. Lajan ol aj heb' yet' heb' ángel. Yuninal ton Dios ol aj heb', yujto ol pitzwokxi heb'.

Hanhejtona' t'a winhaj Moisés chi' yalnakkan Dios t'a skal te' k'i'ix ayoch sk'ak'al, hata' yak'nak kojtakejeli to ol pitzwokxi heb' chamnak, b'aj yalnakkan icha tik: Ha in ton tik sDiosal in winhaj Abraham, winhaj Isaac yet' winhaj Jacob, xchi.
Yuj chi', wach'chom chamnak heb' winh chi', kojtak to manh satnakokel heb' winh t'a junelnhej, yujto yalnak Dios to sDiosal heb' winh yaji. Ha t'a sat Dios, pitzan heb' anima smasanil, xchi Jesús.
Ay juntzanh heb' winh k'ayb'um t'a ley Moisés ix halan t'ay: --Yel ton tzal Mamin k'ayb'um, xchi heb' winh.
Yuj chi' manhxalaj tas syal sk'anb'an heb' winh t'ay.
Ix yalan Jesús t'a heb' winh: --¿Tas yuj ay heb' tz'alani to a Cristo yinhtilal David yaji?
Yujto hanheja' winhaj David chi' alanxikan t'a jun libro yik Salmos: Ha Dios Kajal alannak t'a Wajalil icha tik: Emanh k'ojan t'a in wach' k'ab' tik,
masanto ol wak'kanoch heb' ayoch ajk'olal t'ayach t'a yalanh ok, xchi Dios t'a Wajalil, xchi winhaj David chi'.
Icha chi' yutejnakkan winhaj David yalani to a Cristo ayoch yajalok winh, yuj chi' kojtak to a Cristo chi', manh yinhtilaloknhej David chi' yaji, xchi Jesús t'a heb' winh.
Ayik wan yab'an heb' anima smasanil, ix yalan Jesús icha tik t'a heb' sk'ayb'um:

--Tzeyil wal he b'a yik manh ol ex juwokel yuj sb'eyb'al heb' winh k'ayb'um t'a ley Moisés, yujto scham wal b'at heb' winh yet' juntzanh spichul jukan. Snib'ej heb' winh to tz'em nhojan heb' anima t'a heb' winh b'aj ay mercado. Ha sk'an heb' winh to ha t'a xila heb' niwak winak tz'em k'ojjab' heb' winh t'a yoltak spatil culto. Ayik tz'och wa'el, snib'ej heb' winh tz'em k'ojjab' b'aj tz'em k'ojan heb' winh niwak yelk'ochi.

Syik'anpaxek' heb' winh tas ay t'a heb' ix chamnak yetb'eyum yet' pax spat heb' ix. Slajwi chi', najat syutej yok slesal heb' winh, yik a sna'an heb' anima to malaj smul heb' winh. Palta a heb' winh chi', yelxo wal niwan ya'elal ol ak'jokoch t'a yib'anh heb' winh, xchi Jesús chi'.
Ha junel, ayek' Jesús t'a yamak'il templo. Wan yilani chajtil syutej heb' b'eyum yak'anem yofrenda t'a yol jun chalab' ofrenda.
Ix yilani ix k'och jun ix chamnak yetb'eyum te meb'a'. Ix yak'anem chab' kotak tumin ix t'a yo'ol.
Yuj chi', ix yalan Jesús chi' t'a heb' ayek' ta' yet'ok: --Wal yel swal t'ayex, a jun ix te meb'a' tik, ek'alto yik ix, ix yak' t'a yichanh heb' ix laj yak' yiko'.
Ay heb' haxonhej sobreal stumin syak'a'. Haxo ix meb'a' tik, jantaknhej jab' stumin ix ayek'i ix yak'em ix yofrendaok. Manhxalaj tas ix kan t'a ix, xchi t'a heb'.
Ay juntzanh heb' wan yalani to te wach' yilji stemplo Dios, wach' yaj yet' juntzanh k'e'en k'e'en latz'b'ab'iloch t'ay yet' juntzanh tastak siaj t'ay. Yuj chi' ix yal Jesús t'a heb':
--Ha juntzanh wan eyilan tik, ay jun pekti' ol lajwokel smasanil. Manhxalaj junok k'e'en latz'b'ab'ilk'e tik ol kan t'a yib'anh k'e'en yetk'e'enal, xchi Jesús t'a heb'.
Yuj chi' ix sk'anb'ej heb' t'ay: --Ach ko k'ayb'umal, ¿b'ak'inh ol ujok juntzanh chi'? ¿Tas wal yechel ol sch'ox Dios, ayik toxo ol ujok jun chi'? xchi heb' t'ay.

Yuj chi' ix yalan t'a heb': --Tzeyil wal he b'a yik manh ol ex ak'jok musansatil, yujto tzijtum heb' ol jawok, ol yesanel in b'i heb'. Ol yalan heb': Ha in tik Cristo in, xcham heb'. Ol yalanpax heb': Haxo wal sja stiempoal tik, xcham heb'. Manh ex b'at k'elan t'a heb'.

Ayik ol eyab'an spekal yoch niwak owal, haxo yak'anpax owal heb' komon anima yet' heb' yajal, manh ex te xiwok, yujto a juntzanh chi' yowalil ol b'ab'laj ujok, palta manhoklaj t'a jun ratoal chi' ol lajwokel yol yib'anhk'inal tik, xchi Jesús chi' t'a heb'.
Ix yalanpaxi: --Ol och owal t'a skal juntzanh niwak nación.

Ay juntzanh niwak kixkab' ol laj ek'ok. Ol laj jawok wejel, ol laj yamchaj juntzanh anima yuj niwak ilya t'a junjun chonhab'. Haxo t'a satcha'anh, tzijtum tas ol laj sch'ox sb'a. Ay pax juntzanh niwak yechel ol sch'ox sb'a t'a satcha'anh, ol te xiwpax heb' anima yuj juntzanh chi'.

Palta ayik manto ujok juntzanh chi', ay heb' ol ex yamanok, ol yak' chukal heb' t'ayex. Yujto in k'ayb'um ex, yuj chi' ol laj ex yik'b'at heb' t'a yoltak spatil culto yik ol yak'anoch heb' t'a eyib'anh. Ol ex yak'och heb' t'a preso, ol ex yik'b'at heb' t'a yichanh heb' winh rey yet' heb' winh yajal.
Yuj juntzanh tas ol ak'jokoch t'a eyib'anh chi' ol yal eyalanel wab'ixal t'a yichanh heb' winh yajal chi'.
Manh he b'ab'laj na'ej yuj tas ol eyutej he kolan he b'a t'a heb',
yujto a in ol in b'o eyala'. Ol wak' he jelanil t'a tas ol eyala'. Yuj chi' malaj heb' ajk'o'ol ol yal spakan t'ayex. Malaj junok heb' ol tzak'wan sjelanil t'ayex icha he jelanil ol wak'a'.
Palta a ex tik, a he mam he nun, heb' eyuk'tak, heb' he k'ab' eyok yet' heb' eyamigo, ol meltzaj och heb' ajk'olal t'ayex. Ay ex ol ex smilcham heb'.
Haxo masanil heb' anima ay t'a yol yib'anhk'inal tik, ol och heb' ajk'olal t'ayex, yujto ayoch he pensar t'ayin.
Palta manh ol ex satel-laj, manh wal junok xil he jolom ol satb'atok.
Tato tek'an tzeyutej he b'a, ol eyak' ganar he cha'an he k 'inal t'a wal yel.
Ayik ol heyilani to oyb'ilxok'e Jerusalén yuj heb' soldado, nachajokab'el eyu'uj to wan slajwiel jun chonhab' chi'.

Haxo heb' ayek' t'a yol yik Judea tik, b'atokab'kan heb' elelal t'a tzalkixtak. Ha heb' ayek' t'a chonhab' Jerusalén tik, b'atokab' pax heb' elelal. Haxo heb' ayb'at t'a smunlajel, manhxo'okab' ochta heb' t'a yol chonhab' tik,
yujto a wal t'a jun pekti' chi', ol ja jun niwan ya'elal yuj yowal sk'o'ol Dios. Hato ta' ol elk'och jantak tas tz'ib'ab'ilkan t'a Slolonel Dios.

Ob'iltak heb' ix yab'ix t'a jun pekti' chi' yet' heb' ix wanto schuni yune', yujto niwan ya'elal ol ja t'a yib'anh heb' anima t'a juntzanh lugar tik. Ol yak'kot yowal sk'o'ol Dios t'a yib'anh heb' ketisraelal.

Nanhal heb' ol cham yuj jun owal chi'. Haxo nanhalxo heb', ol b'atkan heb' preso t'a ch'ok chonhab'il. Haxo heb' ch'ok chonhab'il chi' ol ixtan Jerusalén tik, masanto ol lajwok stiempoal yak'an yajalil heb', icha yalnakkan Dios.

Ay pax juntzanh yechel ol sch'ox sb'a t'a k'u, t'a k'e'en uj yet' t'a k'e'en k'anal. Haxo juntzanh nación, ol laj somchaj heb' yuj xiwelal, yujto ol k'anh sk'e wa'an ha' mar, ol k'anh pax yemxi ponhnaj ha'.
Ol laj te xiw heb' anima ayik ol sna'an heb' tas ol ujok t'a jun yol yib'anhk'inal tik, yujto ol tzikub'tanhaj pax juntzanh yipal t'a satcha'anh.
Ichato chi' ol yilan heb' to a in Ak'b'il in kot yuj Dios woch animail tik, ol in emul t'a skal asun yet' jantak in poder yet' in niwan tzikikial.
Ayik ol syamanoch yuji juntzanh chi', tzex tzalaji, tzex k'e k'elan, yujto toxo ol ex kolchajelok, xchi Jesús chi' t'a heb'.
Ixlajwi chi', ix yalan jun ab'ix tik t'a heb': --Tzeyilnab' te' higo, ma juntzanhxo te te' slaj k'ajb'anel xi'il.
Ayik tzeyilani to wanxo swolanxi te' sk'ab', snachajel eyu'uj to wanxo sja stiempoal nhab'ilk'inal.
Hanhejtona' juntzanh swal tik, ayik ol eyilan sja juntzanh chi', nachajokab'el eyu'uj to toxo ol wach' och Dios Yajalil.
Wal yel swal t'ayex, masanil juntzanh tas swal tik ol ujok ayik manto satel-laj juntzanh anima tik.
Ha satcha'anh yet' yol yib'anhk'inal tik, ol lajwokelok, palta a in lolonel, malaj b'ak'inh ol lajwokelok.
Tzeyil wal he b'a. Manh eyak' pitb'ok he b'a yuj pek'al, yuj uk'el anh, ma yuj juntzanhxo tas b'aj tzeyak'och he pensar. Ta ma'ay, ayik ol ja jun k'uhal chi', manh listaok eyaji.
Icha tz'aj yem junok ya'al, icha chi' ol aj sja jun k'uhal chi' t'a yib'anh heb' anima smasanil t'a yol yib'anhk'inal tik.

Yuj chi' lista tzeyutej he b'a. Lesalwanhek t'a masanil tiempo yik wach' tek'an eyaji. Yuj chi' ol yal eyel t'a tas t'inhan sjawi, yik pax manh ol ex k'ixwok eyoch t'a wichanh a in Ak'b'il in kot yuj Dios woch animail tik, xchi Jesús t'a heb'.
Junjun k'u sk'ayb'ej heb' anima Jesús t'a yamak'il stemplo Dios. Haxo t'a tzalan Olivo tzek' ak'wal yuj.
Masanil k'u, spet k'och heb' anima chi' smasanil t'a yamak'il templo chi'. Sb'at smaklan yab' heb' t'ay.
Wan sja stiempoal k'inh yik snachajkoti tas aj yelnakkot heb' israel t'a Egipto, haton yik swa'an ixim pan heb' malaj yich.
Haxo heb' winh sat sacerdote yet' heb' winh k'ayb'um t'a ley Moisés ix sayan modo tas ol aj smilancham Jesús heb' winh t'a k'ub'eltak, yujto xiw heb' winh t'a heb' anima.
Ay jun winh skuch Judas, winh aj Queriot. Yetb'eyum sb'a winh yet' heb' winh uxluchwanh sk'ayb'um Jesús, palta a winh Satanás ix och t'a winh.
Yuj chi' ix b'at winh sk'umej heb' winh sat sacerdote yet' heb' winh yajal yaj t'a heb' winh stanhwan stemplo Dios. Ix yalan winh tas ol yutok yak'anoch Jesús t'a yol sk'ab' heb' winh.
Yuj chi' te wach' ix yab' heb' winh. Ix yak'an strato heb' winh yet' winh t'a jantak tumin ol yak' heb' winh t'a winh.
Yuj chi' ix scha'an yab' winh tas ix yal heb' winh. Ix och ijan winh sayani tas syutej winh yak'anoch Jesús chi' t'a yol sk'ab' heb' winh t'a elk'altak.
Ix k'och sk'uhal swa'an ixim pan heb', haton ixim malaj yich ayemi, yik smiljipaxcham nok' kalnel yik sna'ankot heb' tas aj yelnakkot heb' t'a Egipto.
Haxo Jesús ix chekanb'at winhaj Pedro yet' winhaj Juan, ix yalani: --Ixikek, b'at b'o'ek tas ol kab'lej t'a jun k'inh tik, xchi t'a heb' winh.
--¿B'ajtil a gana sko b'o'o? xchi heb' winh t'ay.
--Ayik ol ex k'och t'a yol chonhab', ay jun winh ol ilchajel eyu'uj, kuchb'il jun ch'ub' ha ha' yuj winh. Tzex och tzak'an yuj winh, masanto tzex k'och yet' winh t'a spat.

Ol eyalan t'a winh aj pat chi: Icha tik ix aj yalankot ko k'ayb'umal t'ayach: ¿B'ajtil ay jun a cuarto b'aj ol in wa yet' heb' winh in k'ayb'um yik sko na'ankot tas aj yelnakkot heb' ko mam kicham t'a Egipto? xchikoti, xe chi t'a winh.
Haxo winh ol ch'oxan jun niwan cuarto t'ayex t'a jun cha'anh. Listaxo yaji. Haxo ta' ol he b'o tas ol kab'lej chi', xchi Jesús t'a heb' winh.
Ixlajwi chi', ix b'at heb' winh. Haxo ix k'och heb' winh, ix yilan heb' winh to ix elk'och icha ix aj yalan Jesús chi'. Yuj chi' hata' ix sb'o heb' winh tas ol yab'lej t'a jun k'inh chi'.
Ayik ix k'och yorail, ix k'och Jesús yet' juntzanhxo heb' winh sk'ayb'um, ix och hoyan heb' winh wa'el t'a spatik te' mexa.
Ix yalan Jesús t'a heb' winh: --Toxon nab'il wu'uj to in gana tzin wa heyet'ok t'a jun k'inh tik, yakb'an manto in chamok.
Swal t'ayex, manhxa b'ak'inh ol in wa t'a jun k'inh tik, masanto ol och junelxo ayik ol wach' och Dios Yajalil, xchi t'a heb' winh.
Ixlajwi chi', ix yik'ank'e wa'an jun waso. Ix yak'an yuj diosal t'a Dios yuj. Ix yalanxi t'a heb' winh: --Chaek jun tik. Mol uk'ejek.
