Yujto swal t'ayex, manhxalaj b'ak'inh ol wuk' yal uwa tik, masanto ol wach' och Dios Yajalil, xchi t'a heb' winh.

Ixlajwi chi', ix yik'ank'e wan jun ixim pan. Ix yak'an yuj diosal t'a Dios yuj ixim. Ix xepanb'at ixim t'a heb' winh. Ix yalani: --Ha jun tik, haton in niwanil tik ol ak'jok eyu'uj. Waek ixim. Tze k'ulejnhej jun tik, yik tzin he na'ankoti, xchi t'a heb' winh.

Icha pax chi' ix yutej junxo waso ayik toxo ix lajwi swa heb', ix yalani: --Ha jun ay t'a yol jun waso tik sch'oxanel jun schab'il strato Dios toto ix b'oi. Yuj in chik'il ol el eyu'uj ol elk'och jun trato chi'.
Palta a winh ol in ak'anoch t'a yol sk'ab' heb' ol in milanchamok, ayek' winh wet' t'a jun mexa tik.
Ha in Ak'b'il in kot yuj Dios woch animail tik, yowalil ol in paxok, ichataxon yaj sb'okani. Palta a wal winh ol in ak'anoch t'a yol sk'ab' chamel chi', te chuk yik winh, xchi Jesús t'a heb' winh.
Yuj chi' ix yal-lan yab' junjun heb' winh, ¿mach onhtaxlaj ol kak'och t'a yol sk'ab' chamel chi'? xchi heb' winh.
Ixlajwi chi', ix laj stelan sb'a heb' sk'ayb'um yuj mach junok heb' ek'al yelk'ochi.
Haxo Jesús ix halan t'a heb': --Ha heb' rey t'a junjun nación, yajal ton yaj heb'. Yet' heb' yajal, wach' heb' yalan heb' anima.

Ha exxo tik, manh eyutok he b'a icha heb' chi'. Tato ay junok mach t'a he kal tik ek'al yelk'ochi, yik'okab'emta sb'a icha junok unin. Hanhejtona' tato ay junok yajal yaj t'a he kal, ichaokab' junok chekab' syutej sb'a.

K'inalok tz'och junok niwan wa'el. ¿Mach junok más niwan yelk'och tze na'a? ¿Am jun k'ojanem wan swa'i, mato a jun wan yak'an serwil? Haton jun k'ojanem wan swa chi' más niwan yelk'ochi, palta a in tik ayinek' t'a he kal icha junok tz'ak'an serwil.
Ha ex tik, ix he tek'b'ej he b'a eyek' wet'ok ayik ix ja juntzanh ya'elal t'a wib'anh.
Yuj chi', icha in yutej ko Mam Dios in yak'anoch yajalil, icha chi' ol ex wutej pax ex wak'anoch yajalil.

Yuj chi' ol yal he wa wet' t'a jun in mexa b'aj ay in och yajalil chi'. Hanhejtona' ol ex em k'ojjab' t'a junjunok he k'ojnub'. Haxo eyoch chi' yajalil t'a heb' lajchawe' makan ketisraelal, xchi Jesús t'a heb' sk'ayb'um chi'.
Ix yalanpax Jesús: --Ach Simón, ina ix sk'an spermiso winh Satanás t'a Dios, yujto snib'ej winh tzex yak' prowal icha tz'aj ixim trigo schayaji.
Palta ix in tewi wal t'a Dios u'uj, yik max ik'el a k'o'ol t'ay. Ha ach tik, ayik ol meltzajxok och a pensar t'ayin, tzak' stek'anil heb' uk'tak, xchi Jesús.
Yuj chi' ix yalan winhaj Simón chi': --Mamin, b'ekan in k'ol in b'at et' t'a preso, wach'chom tzin cham het'ok, xchi winh.
--Pedro, swal t'ayach, ayik manto ok' nok' kaxlanh t'a jun ak'wal tik, oxel ol ik'el t'a ib'anh to manh in ojtakok, xchi Jesús chi' t'a winh.

Ix yalanxi Jesús t'a heb' sk'ayb'um: --Tze nakoti, ayik ex in chekannakb'at junel, maj eyik' he moral, maj eyik' he tumin, maj eyik'paxb'at he xanhab'. ¿Tom ay tas yak'nak palta t'ayex ta'? xchi t'a heb'. --Ma'ay, malaj tasi, xchi heb'.
Haxo tiknaik, mach ex ay he moral, he tumin, tzeyik'b'at heyet'ok. Mach ex malaj eyespada, tze chonhel he chumpa, tze manan eyiko'.

Yujto swal t'ayex, yowalil ol elk'och t'a wib'anh icha tz'ib'ab'ilkan t'a Slolonel Dios, b'aj syalkan icha tik: Icha tz'utaj heb' anima chuk, icha chi' ix utaj winh, xchi. Jantaknhej wab'ixal tz'ib'ab'ilkan t'a Slolonel Dios chi', yowalil ol ujokelk'ochi, xchi Jesús t'a heb'.
Yuj chi' ix yal heb' sk'ayb'um chi' t'ay: --Mamin, ina chab' k'e'en espada tik, xchi heb' t'ay. --Yechelxo chi', xchi Jesús t'a heb'.
Ixlajwi chi', ix elta Jesús t'a yol jun pat b'aj ix wa heb' chi', ix b'at t'a tzalan Olivo ichataxon smodo. Ix och pax tzak'an heb' sk'ayb'um yuj.
Haxo ix k'och ta', ix yalan t'a heb': --Lesalwanhek, yik manh ol ex ak'jok prowal, xchi t'a heb'.
Ixlajwi chi', ix sb'esanel sb'a t'a stz'ey heb'. Icha am snajatil sb'at junok jul-lab', icha chi' ix b'ati. Haxo ta' ix em kuman, ix lesalwi.
Ix yalan icha tik: --Mamin, tato a gana, ik'el jun ya'elal tik t'a wib'anh, palta manhok icha in gana, palta ichaokab' wal a gana, xchi.
Ixlajwi chi', ix sch'oxan sb'a jun ángel ix kot t'a satcha'anh. Ix ul yak'an stek'anil.
Ix te och pitz'an t'a spixan. Yuj chi' yelk'olal ix lesalwi. Haxo yalil tz'em t'a sat lu'um, kalan yaj yet' chik', icha wal yem tz'uj yem t'a sat lu'um chi'.
Ixlajwi slesalwi, ix meltzajxikot b'aj aykan heb' sk'ayb'um chi'. Haxo ix k'och t'a heb', waynakb'at heb', yujto ix te och pitz'an kuselal t'a spixan heb'.
Yuj chi', ix yalan t'a heb': --¿Tas yuj tzex te wayi? K'eanhek wa'an, lesalwanhek, yik wach' manh ol ex meltzaj t'a he patik ayik ol ex ak'jok prowal, xchi t'a heb'.

Wanto slolon Jesús chi', ix k'och heb' tzijtumal anima. Haxo winhaj Judas, yetb'eyum sb'a yet' heb' uxluchwanh sk'ayb'um Jesús chi', a winh b'ab'el sk'och yuj heb'. Ix snitzanb'at sb'a winh stz'ub' sti' Jesús chi'.
Haxo Jesús chi' ix halan t'a winh: --Judas, ¿tom icha tik tz'aj in ak'anoch t'a yol sk'ab' chamel a in Ak'b'il in kot yuj Dios woch animail tik? xchi.
Haxo heb' ayek' yet' Jesús chi', ayik ix yilan heb' tas wan sja t'a yib'anh ix sk'anb'an heb' t'ay: --Mamin, ¿tzam yal ko xikan heb' t'a k'e'en espada tik? xchi heb' t'ay.
Wal t'a jun rato chi', ay jun winh t'a skal heb' sk'ayb'um Jesús chi' ix tzepanel schikin jun winh schekab' winh sat sacerdote t'a swach'.
Haxo Jesús ix halan t'a heb': --Aktejek, k'okb'ilxo chi', xchi t'a heb'. Haxo Jesús ix yaman schikin winh chi', yet'nhej chi' ix ochxikani.

Ha heb' winh sat sacerdote, heb' winh yajal yaj t'a stemplo Dios yet' heb' winh ichamtak winak ay yopisio, ix k'och heb' winh syam Jesús chi'. Yuj chi' ix yal Jesús chi' t'a heb' winh: --¿Tas waj tzeyila'? ¿Tom kuchb'um in t'a heb' sk'ulan chukal yuj chi' tzex ja t'ayin yet' k'e'en espada yet' te te'?
Ayinnhej ek' eyet' t'a yamak'il stemplo Dios t'a junjun k'u, palta maj in eyama'. Palta hato tiknaik yorail he k'ulan jun tik yet' yipalil winh aj k'ik' k'inal, xchi t'a heb' winh.
Ixlajwi chi', ix yamji Jesús yuj heb' winh. Ix yik'anb'at heb' winh t'a spat winh sat sacerdote chi'. Haxo winhaj Pedro, najat tzak'anto sb'at winh yuj.
Haxo t'a yamak'il ti' pat chi' ix yak'och jun k'ak' heb' winh. Ix och hoyan heb' winh t'a sti' te', ix em k'ojan heb' winh. Ix em k'ojan pax winhaj Pedro chi' t'a skal heb' winh.
Haxo jun ix criada, ayik ix yilan ix to k'ojanem winhaj Pedro chi' t'a sti' te' k'ak' chi', ix och k'elan ix t'a winh, ix yalan ix: --Ha jun winh tik, yetb'eyum sb'a winh yet' Jesús tik, xchi ix.
Haxo winh, elanhchamel ix yik'el winh t'a yib'anh, ix yalan winh: --Ach ix, manh wojtakok jun winh tzal chi', xchi winh t'a ix.
Junanto rato chi', ay junxo ix och k'elan t'a winh, ix yalani: --Ha ach tik, etb'eyum a b'a yet' heb', xchi t'a winhaj Pedro chi'. --Wal yel ma'ay, manh wetb'eyumoklaj in b'a yet' heb', xchi winh.
Ay am tom junok hora chi', yelk'olal ix yal junxo winh: --Wal yel a jun winh tik, yetb'eyum sb'a winh yet'ok, yujto aj Galilea heb', xchi winh.
--Toton ma'ay, manh wojtakok juntzanh tzal chi', xchi winhaj Pedro chi' t'a winh. Ayik wanto yalan juntzanh chi' winh ix ok' nok' kaxlanh.

Ix kot k'elelok Jesús Kajal chi' t'a winh. Yuj chi' ix snakot winh tas ix yalkan Jesús. Ichaton tik ix yutej yalankan t'a winh: Ayik manto ok' nok' kaxlanh t'a jun ak'wal tik, oxel ol ik'el t'a ib'anh to manh in ojtakoklaj, xchi t'a winh.
Yuj chi' ix sb'eselta sb'a winh t'a skal heb'. Ix te ok' wal winh sik'lab'il.
Haxo heb' stanhwumal Jesús ix och ijan heb' sb'uchwaj t'ay. Ix laj smak'an pax heb'.
Ix smakan sat heb'. Ix stz'itanb'at sti' heb'. Ixlajwi chi', ix sk'anb'an heb' t'ay: --Al t'ayonh mach tzach mak'ani, xchi heb' t'ay.
Manh jantakok tas ix yal heb' t'ay yik sb'uchwaj heb' t'ay.

Haxo ix sakb'i, ix smolb'an sb'a heb' ichamtak winak ay yopisio t'a skal heb' israel, heb' winh sat sacerdote yet' heb' winh k'ayb'um t'a ley Moisés. Ix yik'anb'at Jesús heb' winh t'a yichanh winh sat yajal. Haxo ta' ix sk'anb'ej heb' winh t'ay:
--Al t'ayonh, ¿tom a ach tik Cristo ach? xchi heb' winh t'ay. --Nab'anhej swal t'ayex, ¿tom ol he cha eyab' t'ayin?
Tato a in tzin k'anb'ej junok tas t'ayex, ¿tom ol eyal t'ayin? ¿Tom ol in eyak'el t'a libre?
Palta a in Ak'b'il in kot yuj Dios woch animail tik, a tiknaik ol in k'ochkan k'ojan t'a swach' k'ab' Dios, haton jun masanil tas syal yuj, xchi Jesús t'a heb' winh.
Masanil heb' winh ix k'anb'an t'ay: --¿Tom Yuninal ach Dios jun? xchi heb' winh t'ay. --Ha in ton tik Yuninal in, icha tzeyal chi', xchi t'a heb' winh.
Yuj chi' ix yal heb' winh. --¿Tasto tz'och testigo ku'uj? Yujto a onh wal lak'an ix kab' yalan winh, xchi heb' winh.
Ixlajwi chi' ix k'e wa'an heb' smasanil. Ix yik'anb'at Jesús heb' t'a yichanh winhaj Pilato.

Hata' ix syamoch heb' yak'anoch juntzanh es t'a yib'anh. Ix laj yalan heb': --Ix kila' to a winh wan yak'an somchajel heb' ketchonhab'. Syalanpax winh to max yal kak'an k'e'en tumin sk'anjiel t'ayonh yuj winh yajal t'a Roma. Ha wal winh tz'alanpaxi to Cristo winh, syalelk'ochi to rey winh, xchi heb' t'a winhaj Pilato chi'.
Yuj chi' ix sk'anb'ej winhaj Pilato chi' t'ay: --Tzin k'anb'ej t'ayach, ¿tom sreyal ach heb' israel? xchi winh t'ay. --Ha in toni, ichaton tzutej halan chi', xchi Jesús t'a winh.
Yuj chi', ix yal winhaj Pilato chi' t'a heb' winh sat sacerdote yet' t'a heb' anima chi': --Malaj jab'ok smul jun winh tik tz'ilchaj wu'uj, xchi winh.

Palta haxo heb', yelk'olal yalan heb': --Ha winh tik, masanil heb' anima aj Judea tik wan somchajel yuj juntzanh k'ayb'ub'al syak' winh. Hato t'a Galilea ix schael yich winh yalani, masanto ix jawi winh t'a Judea tik, xchi heb' t'a winhaj Pilato chi'.
Ayik ix yab'an juntzanh chi' winhaj Pilato chi', ix sk'anb'an winh yab' t'a heb', tato a Jesús aj Galilea.
Haxo yik ix yab'an winh to aj Galilea, yuj chi' ix yak'anb'at t'a winhaj Herodes yajal t'a Galilea chi' yujto ayek' winh t'a Jerusalén t'a juntzanh k'uhal chi'.
Ayik ix yilan winhaj Herodes chi' sk'och Jesús, te wach' ix yab' winh, yujto ayxo stiempoal yab'an spekal winh. Yuj chi' sganaxo winh slolon yet'ok. Snib'ej wal winh syil sb'o'an junok milagro.
Tzijtum tas ix sk'anb'ej winh t'ay, haxo Jesús manh jab'ok ix tak'wi t'a winh.
Haxo heb' winh sat sacerdote yet' heb' winh k'ayb'um t'a ley Moisés ayek' ta', yelk'olal ix yak'och heb' winh t'a yib'anh.

Yuj chi' a winhaj Herodes chi' yet' heb' soldado, ix sb'aj Jesús chi' heb'. Ix sb'uchan pax heb'. Ix stz'akan yak'och juntzanh pichul heb' te wach' t'ay, icha spichul heb' winh rey. Ixlajwi chi', ix yak'anxi meltzaj Jesús winh t'a winhaj Pilato.
Ha t'a jun k'uhal chi' ix yamigoejk'e sb'a winhaj Pilato chi' yet' winhaj Herodes, yujto ha t'a yalanhtaxo yajk'o'ol sb'a heb' winh.
Haxo winhaj Pilato chi' ix molb'an heb' winh sat sacerdote, heb' winh ay yopisio yet' pax heb' anima smasanil.

Ix yalanelta winh t'a skal heb': --Ha winh ix ul eyak' tik t'ayin, yujto tzeyala' to somchajel heb' anima yuj winh, palta ina t'a eyichanh ix in k'anb'ej wab' t'a winh, palta malaj jab'ok smul winh scheklajelta wuj icha ix aj eyalani.
Hanheja' pax winhaj Herodes, malaj tas ix ilchaj yuj winh t'a winh. Yuj chi' ix schekxikot winh t'ayonh. Inai, malaj jab'ok smul winh yik smoj schami.
Yuj chi', tonhej ol in chek mak'jok winh, ol wak'anxiel winh t'a libre, xchi winh t'a heb'.
Haxo yik ix yab'an heb' anima to icha chi', ix laj awajk'e heb': --Ha winh tik, chamokab' winh. Aokab' winhaj Barrabás chi' tz'el t'a libre, xchi heb'.
Ha winhaj Barrabás chi', preso yaj winh, yujto lokan winh yet' heb' winh ix ak'an owal yet' heb' winh yajal t'a yol chonhab' chi'. Mak'umcham anima pax winh.
Haxo winhaj Pilato chi' snib'ej winh syak'el Jesús t'a libre. Yuj chi' icha chi' ix yutej winh yalanxi t'a heb' anima.
Palta ayik ix yab'an heb' to icha chi', ix k'e umnaj heb' yawaji: --Kulusejk'e winh. Kulusejk'e winh, xchi heb'.

Ix yalanxi winhaj Pilato chi' yoxelal t'a heb': --¿Tas wal smul winh t'ayex jun? Malaj wal jab'ok smul winh tz'ilchaj wu'uj yik smoj schami. Yuj chi' tonhej ol in chek mak'jok winh, ol wak'anxiel winh t'a libre, xchi winh t'a heb'.
Haxo heb', ix te k'e umnaj yawaji to yowalil skulusajk'ei. Te cha'anh ix awajk'e heb' yet' heb' winh sat sacerdote. Yuj chi' ix yak' ganar heb'.
Ix yalan winhaj Pilato chi': Ujokab' icha snib'ej heb', xchi winh.
Haxo winh lokan t'a skal owal chi', winh mak'umcham anima chi', winh preso yaji, a winh ix ak'jielta t'a libre icha snib'ej heb'. Haxo Jesús ix ak'jikanoch t'a yol sk'ab' heb' icha snib'ej.

Ayik wan yik'anb'at Jesús heb' b'aj ol chamok, ay jun winh aj Cirene skuchan Simón, spetoj winh t'a smunlajel, ix yamchaj winh yuj heb' soldado. Haxo winh ix chekji skuchb'at skulusal Jesús chi'. Ix och tzak'an winh yuj.
Tzijtum heb' anima ix och tzak'an yuj. Yet' pax heb' ix ix, wek'ek'i yel yaw heb' ix yok' yuj.
Haxo Jesús ix meltzajb'at k'elan t'a heb' ix, ix yalani: --Ex ix aj Jerusalén, manh ex ok' wu'uj. Ok'anhek eyu'uj yet' yuj heb' eyune',
yujto ay wal jun k'uhal ol jawok, ol eyalani: Ha wal heb' ix malaj yune', heb' ix toxon max unewi yet' heb' ix manh yojtakok yak'an chunok yune', te wach' yik heb' ix, xe chama.
Ha t'a jun pekti' chi', ol laj yal heb' anima icha tik: Tzok wal kot juntzanh witz yet' juntzanh tzalkixtak tik t'a kib'anh yik tzonh sk'ub'ejeli, xcham heb'.

Ha in tik, lajan in icha junok te te' ya'ax, palta ina wal tas syak'och heb' t'a wib'anh. Okxom wal a ex tik. Yelxo wal niwan tas ol ak'jokoch t'a eyib'anh, yujto lajan ex icha junok te te' takinhxo, xchi Jesús t'a heb' ix.
Ay pax chawanh heb' winh ay smul ix ik'jib'at yet' Jesús chi', yik skulusajk'e heb' winh yet'ok.

Ix k'och heb' t'a jun lugar skuchan B'aj Ay Sb'akil Jolom. Hata' ix kulusajk'e Jesús yuj heb' winh soldado. Ix kulusajpaxk'e chawanh heb' winh ay smul chi' yet'ok, jun winh t'a swach', jun winh t'a sk'exanh. Junjun skulusal junjun heb'.

Ayik wan sk'e t'unhunhok Jesús yuj heb', ix yalani: --Mamin, ak' niwank'olal heb', yujto manh yojtakok heb' tas wan sk'ulani, xchi t'a Dios. Haxo heb' winh soldado, ix yak' suerte heb' winh yik spojanek' spichul Jesús chi' heb' winh t'a spatik.

Haxo heb' anima, wan yilan heb' tas wan yuji chi'. Hanheja' pax heb' winh yajal, ix sb'uch Jesús heb' winh. Ix laj yalan heb' winh: --Ab'i chi' kolwajwum winh t'a juntzanhxo. Skolokab' pax sb'a winh tiknaik, tato t'a wal yel Cristo winh, winh sik'b'ilel yuj Dios, xchi heb' winh.
Hanheja' ix b'uchji pax yuj heb' winh soldado. Ix k'och heb' winh t'a stz'ey. Ix yak'an vinagre heb' winh yuk'ej.
Ix yalan heb' winh t'ay: --Tato yel Sreyal ach heb' israel, kolto naik a b'a kila', xchi heb' winh t'ay.
Ay jun letra ix tz'ib'ajoch t'a sjolom te' skulusal, xchi icha tik: Ha winh tik Sreyal heb' israel, xchi.
Ay pax jun winh kulusab'ilk'e yet'ok ix b'uchani, ix yalan winh icha tik: --Tato yel Cristo ach, kol a b'a kila', tzonh a kolan paxi, xchi winh t'ay.
Haxo junxo winh yetb'eyum winh ix kachani, ix yalan winh: --¿Tom max ach xiw t'a Dios? Ina lajan kajoch t'a yol sk'ab' jun ya'elal tik yet'ok.
Ha onh tik, smoj wal skab' sya'il ko cha'an spak ko mul, palta a jun winh tik, malaj tas ix smulej, xchi winh.
Ixlajwi chi' ix yalan winh t'a Jesús: --Ach Jesús, tzin a nakoti ayik ol ach ja ak' Yajalil, xchi winh t'ay.
Ix yalan Jesús t'a winh: --Wal yel swal t'ayach, ha t'a jun k'u tik ol ach k'och wet' t'a swach'ilal, xchi t'a winh.
Ayik toxo tz'och chimk'uhalil, ix k'ik'b'i k 'inal t'a masanil yol yib'anhk'inal tik masanto t'a a las tres yik yemk'uhalil.
Ha yok k'u, majxo yak'laj yok. Haxo k'apak cortina ayoch smakulok snanhal yol stemplo Dios, ix nhik'chaj snanhal k'apak.
Haxo Jesús te cha'anh ix awaji, ix yalan icha tik: --Mamin, swab'enejkanoch in pixan t'a yol a k'ab', xchi t'a Dios. Ix lajwinhej yalan jun chi', ix chami.
Haxo jun winh capitán aj Roma, ayik ix yilan juntzanh chi' winh, ix yal wach' lolonel winh t'a Dios, ix yalan winh icha tik: --Wal yel a jun winh tik, te malaj smul winh, xchi winh.
Haxo masanil heb' anima ayek' chi' ta', ix yil heb' tas ix uji chi'. Ix laj paxta heb', ix och wal pitz'an kusk'olal t'a spixan heb'.
Haxo jantaknhej heb' ojtannak Jesús yet' juntzanh heb' ix ix kotnak yet' t'a Galilea, najatto ix laj kotkan t'anhjab' heb' ix.
Ay jun winh skuchan José, aj chonhab' Arimatea t'a yol yik Judea. Wach' winh, tojol spensar winh. Ay pax yopisio winh yet' heb' winh yajal.
Palta maj yak'och sb'a winh yet' heb' winh ix ak'anoch chamel t'a yib'anh Jesús chi'. Wan stanhwan winh swach' och Dios Yajalil.
Ix k'och winh t'a winhaj Pilato, yik sk'ananemta sniwanil Jesús winh.

Ixlajwi yik'an spermiso winh chi', ix b'at yak'an ik'jokemta sniwanil chi' winh. Ix sb'ak'anoch jun sábana winh t'a spatik. Ixlajwi chi' ix b'at yak'an ak'jok och sniwanil winh t'a yol jun k'e'en k'e'en joyb'ilel yo'ol. Ha t'a jun k'e'en chi', manta junok mach smukchaji.
Haton t'a jun k'uhal chi' wanxo yak'an lista sb'a heb' yuj sk'uhal ik'oj ip toxo ol yamchaj ochok.
Haxo heb' ix ix kotnak yet' Jesús t'a Galilea, ix b'at heb' ix yil k'e'en k'e'en b'aj ix mukchaj chi'. Ix yilan heb' ix chajtil ix yutej heb' yak'anoch sniwanil chi' t'a yol k'e'en.

Ixlajwi chi', ix paxta heb' ix t'a sposado. Ix laj sb'o'an juntzanh yal suk'uk'i sjab' heb' ix yet' juntzanh wach' sukjioch t'a sniwanil Jesús chi'. Haxo yik ix k'och yorail sk'uhal ik'oj ip, ix yik'an yip heb' ix icha yalan jun cheknab'il t'a ley.
Ayik ayto sk'an sakb'i t'a domingoal, haton jun b'ab'el k'u yik semana, ix b'at heb' ix ix chi' b'aj mukb'il sniwanil Jesús chi'. Yet'nak juntzanh yal suk'uk'i sjab' chi' heb' ix b'ob'il yuj.
Haxo ix k'och heb' ix, ix yilan heb' ix to toxo ix el k'e'en smakul chi'.
Ix och heb' ix t'a yol k'e'en, ix yilan heb' ix to manhxalaj sniwanil Jesús Kajal ayek'i.
Ix te satb'at sk'o'ol heb' ix yilani. Haxo ix yilan heb' ix ayek' chawanh ángel icha yilji winak, linhjab'ek' t'a stz'ey heb' ix. Toxonhej stzikiki spichul heb'.
Yuj chi' ix te xiw heb' ix, ix em kumjab' heb' ix t'a sat lu'um. Haxo ix yalan heb' ángel chi' t'a heb' ix: --¿Tas yuj tze say jun pitzan t'a yol b'aj smukchaj heb' chamnak tik?
Manhxo ayokek'laj t'a tik. Toxo ix pitzwixi. Naekkot tas yalnak t'ayex, ayik aytoek' heyet'ok t'a Galilea.

Ayik yalani to a jun Ak'b'ilkot yuj Dios yoch animail, yowalil ol ak'jokoch t'a yol sk'ab' heb' anima chuk spensar, ol kulusajk'e yuj heb'. Haxo t'a schab'jial ol pitzwokxi. Icha chi' yutejnak yalankan t'ayex, xchi heb' ángel chi' t'a heb' ix.
Ix snakot heb' ix tas yalnakkan Jesús chi',
yuj chi' ix paxta heb' ix ta', ix b'at yalan heb' ix t'a heb' uxluchwanh sk'ayb'um Jesús chi' yet' t'a heb' sk'ayb'um smasanil.
Ha heb' ix ix b'at halan ab'ix tik, haton ix María aj Magdala, ix Juana yet' ix María snun winhaj Jacobo. Ay pax juntzanhxo heb' ix yetb'eyum sb'a yet' heb' ix.
Palta a heb' schekab' Jesús chi', tonhej ste komon lolon heb' ix sna'an heb'. Maj schalaj yab' heb' t'a heb' ix.

Haxo winhaj Pedro yelk'olal ix b'at winh b'aj mukan chi'. Ayik ix k'och winh, ix em nhojan winh yilanoch t'a yol k'e'en, ix yilan winh to haxonhej k'apak sábana ix b'ak'chajoch t'a sniwanil Jesús chi' aykan sch'okoj. Ix paxta winh, ix te sat sk'o'ol winh yuj tas ix uji chi'.
Ha t'a jun k'uhal chi', ay chawanh heb' sk'ayb'um wan sb'at t'a jun b'e sk'och t'a chonhab' Emaús. Ha jun chonhab' chi', ay am oxeok legua skal yet' Jerusalén.
Wan sb'ey heb', wan yalub'tanhan heb' tas juntzanh ix uji.
Ayik wan yalub'tanhan heb' chi', ix k'och Jesús, ix yetb'atan sb'a yet' heb'.
Ix moyjikan sat heb' yuj. Wach'chom tz'ilji yuj heb', palta maj nachajel-laj yuj heb' tato ha'.
Ix sk'anb'an Jesús t'a heb': --¿Tas wal eyalub'tanhej tzex b'eyi? xchi t'a heb'. Ix och wa'an heb', te kuseltak yilji heb'.
Ay jun winh skuch Cleofas ix tak'wi t'ay: --Inatax yojtak heb' anima smasanil tas ix uji t'a Jerusalén t'a ewi chab'ji tik. Ha hachxo tik, ¿tom maj ab' jab'ok? Ina ach ek' ta', xchi winh t'ay.

--¿Tas juntzanh ix uji chi' jun? xchi Jesús chi' t'a heb' winh. --Ay jun aj Nazaret skuch Jesús. Schekab' ton wal Dios yaji. Ha t'a yichanh Dios yet' t'a yichanh heb' chonhab', te niwan yelk'och tas ix sk'ulej yet' tas ix yala'.
Palta a heb' winh sat sacerdote yet' heb' winh yajal ix ak'anoch t'a yol sk'ab' chamel. Yuj chi' ix kulusajk'ei.
Ix kak'och yipok ko k'o'ol to ol onh skolel a onh aj Israel onh tik. Chab'jitax ix uji jun chi' tiknaik.
Palta ay juntzanh heb' ix ketb'eyum ko b'a yet'ok, sat ko k'o'ol yuj tas syal heb' ix, a ix sakb'i ix b'at heb' ix yil jun k'e'en b'aj ochkan sniwanil Jesús chi'.

Ix ab' yilan heb' ix, manhxalaj sniwanil ayek'i. Ixlajwi chi', xit' yalan heb' ix t'ayonh to icha wayich ix aj yilan chawanh ángel heb' ix. Ix ab' yalan heb' ángel chi' t'a heb' ix to a Jesús toxo ix pitzwixi.
Ixlajwi chi', ix b'at juntzanh heb' ketb'eyum yila'. Icha wal ix aj yalan heb' ix chi', icha wal chi' ix aj yilan heb'. Haxo pax Jesús, maj yil-laj heb', xchi heb' t'ay.
Haxo Jesús ix halan t'a heb': --Ha ex tik malaj jab'ok he pensar, max he b'alaj ak'ejochlaj t'a he k'o'ol tastak yalnakkan heb' schekab' Dios t'a peka'.
Ha Cristo chi', yowalil ix yab' sya'il, ayik mantzak och Yajalil, xchi t'a heb'.

Ixlajwi chi', ix och ijan yalan t'a heb' b'ajtaktil tz'ib'ab'ilkan yab'ixal t'a Slolonel Dios. Ix scha'ankot yalan tastak tz'ib'ab'ilkan yuj winhaj Moisés, masanto t'a tas tz'ib'ab'ilkan yuj heb' schekab' Dios t'a peka'.
Ayik ix k'och heb' t'a jun chonhab' b'aj wan sb'at heb' chi', haxo Jesús ijan b'enhej ix ek'b'ati.
Haxo heb' ix ak'an pural skani. Ix yalan heb' t'ay: --Kananh ket'ok, ina wanxo yem k'u, toxo wal ol k'ik'b'ok, xchi heb' t'ay. Yuj chi' ix och t'a yol spat heb', ix kan yet' heb'.
Ayik ix em k'ojan t'a te' mexa yet' heb', ix yik'ank'e wa'an jun ixim pan. Ix yak'an yuj diosal t'a Dios yuj ixim. Ixlajwi chi', ix och ijan spukanb'at ixim t'a heb'.
Ha t'a jun rato chi', ichato ix jakwi sat heb'. Ix yilanoch heb' to a Jesús. Palta ix satem t'a stz'ey heb', haxo ix yilan heb', manhxalaj mach.
Ix yalan heb': --Yel toni, ix och pitz'an t'a ko k'o'ol yuj a ix yalan t'ayonh t'a yol b'e, ayik ix yak'anpax nachajel ku'uj tastak tz'ib'ab'ilkan t'a Slolonel Dios, xchi heb'.
T'a jun rato chi' ix k'e wa'an heb', ix pax heb' t'a Jerusalén. Hata' ix ilchaj heb' uxluchwanh schekab' Jesús yuj heb' yet' juntzanhxo yetb'eyum heb'. Molanek' heb'.
Haxo heb' chi', ix halan t'a heb' chawanh chi': --T'a wal yel ix pitzwixi Jesús Kajal. Ix sch'ox sb'a t'a winhaj Simón tik, xchi heb'.
Ixlajwi chi', haxo heb' chawanh chi' ix halani tas ix sk'ulej heb' t'a yol b'e yet' pax tas ix aj snachajel yuj heb' to a Jesús ayik ix spukanek' jun ixim pan chi'.
Wanto yalan jun chi' heb', haxo ix yilan heb' ayxo ek' Jesús t'a skal heb'. Ix yalani: --Junk'olalokab' eyaji, xchi t'a heb'.
Ha heb' chi', tonhej ix satb'at sk'o'ol heb'. Ix laj xiwk'e heb'. Ha sna'an heb' to a junok pixan sch'ox sb'a t'a heb'.
Ix yalan Jesús t'a heb': --¿Tas yuj tzex te xiwi? ¿Tas yuj ay he chab'k'olal t'ayin?
Ileknab' in k'ab' yet' wok tik. Hanhejtona' a in. Yamlejeknab'i, tzeyilani tato a junok pixan, ¿tom ay sb'ak'chil junok pixan yet' sb'akil syal tze yam icha wik tik? xchi t'a heb'.
Ixlajwi yalan jun chi' t'a heb', ix sch'oxan sk'ab' yet' yok t'a heb'.
Wach'chom stzalaj heb', palta hanheja' maj yak'ochlaj heb' t'a sk'o'ol, yujto tonhej ste sat sk'o'ol heb'. Yuj chi' ix yal t'a heb': --¿Mama jab'ok tas tzin wa t'a tik? xchi.
Haxo heb' ix ak'an jab' b'olb'il chay t'ay.
Ix scha'an t'a heb', ix yab'lan t'a yichanh heb'.

Ixlajwi chi' ix yalan t'a heb': --Ha tiknaik, ix elk'och tas ix walkan t'ayex ayik ayinto ek' heyet'ok. Walnakkan t'ayex to yowalil ol elk'och jantaknhej wab'ixal tz'ib'yajkan t'a ley Moisés, tas tz'ib'ab'il pax kan yuj heb' schekab' Dios yet' juntzanh wab'ixal t'a libro Salmos, xchi t'a heb'.
Ichato chi', ix ak'ji jakwok spensar heb' yuj, yik snachajel yuj heb' tas tz'ib'ab'ilkan t'a Slolonel Dios.
Ix yalan t'a heb': --Ha t'a Slolonel Dios tz'ib'ab'ilkan wab'ixal a in Cristo in tik, to yowalil in chami, haxo t'a schab'jial in pitzwixi t'a skal heb' chamnak.

Hanhejtona', yowalil ol aljokel wab'ixal t'a skal heb' anima t'a junjun nación. Ol aljokel t'a skal heb' to yowalil sna sb'a heb', yik ol ak'jok lajwok smul heb'. Schael yich t'a Jerusalén tik masanto b'aj slajwik'och yol yib'anhk'inal tik.
Ha ex tik, ol eyak' testigoal he b'a t'a juntzanh tik.
Ha in xo, ol b'at in chekkot jun yalnak Dios to ol yak'kot t'ayex. Palta tanhwejekkan t'a Jerusalén tik, masanto ol he cha jun poder ol ak'jokemta t'ayex t'a satcha'anh, xchi Jesús t'a heb'.
Ixlajwi chi' ix yik'anb'at heb' sk'ayb'um t'a slak'anil chonhab' Betania. Hata' ix yik'cha'anh sk'ab', ix sk'anan swach'k'olal Dios t'a yib'anh heb'.
Wanto sk'anan jun chi', ix paxk'e t'a satcha'anh, ix kan heb' yuj.
Ixlajwi yak'anem sb'a heb' t'ay, te tzalajk'olal ix pax heb' t'a Jerusalén.
Junjun k'u ix och heb' t'a yol yamak'il stemplo Dios. Ix yalan wach' lolonel heb' t'ay.
